<span data-as="p">Claude Code resolves a <code>.</code> entry to the project root in project settings and to <code>~/.claude</code> in user settings. Claude Code merges entries across every settings file the session loads unless <a class="link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-allowmanagedreadpathsonly"><code>allowManagedReadPathsOnly</code></a> is set.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-filesystem-allowmanagedreadpathsonly"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-allowmanagedreadpathsonly">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.filesystem.allowManagedReadPathsOnly</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Honor only the <a class="link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-allowread"><code>allowRead</code></a> entries that come from managed settings, so developers can’t re-open read access to paths your organization blocked. Claude Code still merges <code>denyRead</code> entries from every settings scope the session loads.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code honors only the <code>allowRead</code> entries from managed settings</li>
<li><code>false</code>: <code>allowRead</code> entries merge from every settings scope the session loads</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#keep-developers-from-widening-the-policy">Keep developers from widening the policy</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-filesystem-disabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-disabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.filesystem.disabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Skip filesystem isolation while keeping network isolation. Sandboxed commands get unrestricted read and write access to the host filesystem, and their network egress stays confined to <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-alloweddomains"><code>network.allowedDomains</code></a>. Use it when you sandbox to control where commands connect rather than what they write. Requires Claude Code v2.1.216 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. When managed settings configure <code>sandbox.filesystem</code> at all, or list a <code>sandbox.credentials.files</code> entry with <code>"mode": "deny"</code>, only managed settings can set it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code skips filesystem isolation and keeps network isolation</li>
<li><code>false</code>: filesystem isolation stays on</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code>, so filesystem isolation stays on</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This leaves the filesystem open and confines network egress to GitHub and npm:</span>

<span data-as="p">With the layer off, Claude Code doesn’t enforce <code>denyRead</code> or <code>credentials.files</code> <code>deny</code> entries, while <code>credentials.envVars</code> entries and applied <code>mask</code> entries keep working. <a class="link" href="#sandbox-autoallowbashifsandboxed"><code>autoAllowBashIfSandboxed</code></a> still defaults to <code>true</code>, so set it to <code>false</code> to keep prompting. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#disable-filesystem-isolation">Disable filesystem isolation</a> for the full list of sources that can set it and what changes when isolation is off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.216 or later.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-ignoreviolations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-ignoreviolations">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.ignoreViolations</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Silence sandbox violation reports for paths you expect a command to probe and be refused, such as a tool that checks <code>/etc/hosts</code> on startup, so those denials don’t show up as violations or in what Claude sees. The sandbox still blocks the access; only the report is suppressed. Keys are substrings to match against the command, with <code>*</code> matching every command, and values are substrings of the violation to ignore for that command, such as a filesystem path.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object mapping a command substring to an array of violation substrings, usually paths</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so every violation is reported</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-enableweakernestedsandbox"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-enableweakernestedsandbox">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.enableWeakerNestedSandbox</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run the Linux sandbox inside an unprivileged Docker container, where bubblewrap can’t mount a fresh <code>/proc</code>. Instead the inner sandbox bind-mounts the container’s existing <code>/proc</code>, which exposes process information that a fresh mount would hide. This reduces security; use it only when the outer container already provides the isolation you need.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the inner sandbox bind-mounts the container’s existing <code>/proc</code> instead of mounting a fresh one</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the sandbox mounts a fresh <code>/proc</code>, which doesn’t work in an unprivileged Docker container</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Let sandboxed commands on macOS reach the system TLS trust service, <code>com.apple.trustd.agent</code>. Go-based tools such as <code>gh</code>, <code>gcloud</code>, and <code>terraform</code> need it to verify TLS certificates when you use <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-httpproxyport"><code>network.httpProxyPort</code></a> with a MITM proxy and a custom CA. This reduces security by opening a potential data exfiltration path through the trust service.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: sandboxed commands on macOS can reach <code>com.apple.trustd.agent</code></li>
<li><code>false</code>: sandboxed commands on macOS can’t reach the system TLS trust service</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-allowappleevents"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-allowappleevents">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.allowAppleEvents</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Let sandboxed commands on macOS send Apple Events, which <code>open</code>, <code>osascript</code>, and tools that open URLs in a browser need; without it they fail with error <code>-600</code>. This removes code-execution isolation: sandboxed commands can launch other applications unsandboxed with no user prompt, and can send AppleScript commands to running applications such as Terminal, subject to the per-app macOS automation-consent prompt (TCC).</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: sandboxed commands on macOS can send Apple Events</li>
<li><code>false</code>: sandboxed commands on macOS can’t send Apple Events, so <code>open</code> and <code>osascript</code> fail with error <code>-600</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Point the sandbox at a ripgrep binary of your own instead of the one Claude Code uses, for example when your platform needs a differently built <code>rg</code>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>command</code>, the path to the ripgrep binary, and optional <code>args</code>, an array of arguments to prepend</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the sandbox uses the same ripgrep binary as Claude Code. That is the bundled binary unless you set <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP</code></a> to <code>0</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Point the sandbox at a bubblewrap binary installed outside <code>PATH</code>, such as a vendored copy on an air-gapped host. Claude Code uses the path both for the startup dependency check and when it wraps each sandboxed command.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a>. Claude Code reads it only from managed settings so that a user, project, or local file can’t point the sandbox at a different binary.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, an absolute path; Claude Code drops a relative path and falls back to <code>PATH</code> lookup</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code finds <code>bwrap</code> on <code>PATH</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Linux and WSL2 only.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Declare the credential files and environment variables to <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#protect-credentials">protect from sandboxed commands</a>. Each entry names a file <code>path</code> or a variable <code>name</code> and a <code>mode</code>: <code>deny</code> hides the credential inside the sandbox, and <code>mask</code> shows sandboxed commands a placeholder while the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#mask-credentials">sandbox proxy</a> substitutes the real value on outbound requests. Claude Code protects only the entries you list; there is no built-in credential deny list. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code honors <code>mask</code> entries, <code>allowPlaintextInject</code>, <code>awsPairs</code>, and <code>sigv4</code> only from user settings, managed settings, and the <code>--settings</code> flag.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>files</code>, <code>envVars</code>, <code>allowPlaintextInject</code>, <code>awsPairs</code>, and <code>sigv4</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no credentials are protected</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This hides your AWS credentials file and removes <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code> from sandboxed commands:</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">  }</span></span>

<span data-as="p">The <code>deny</code> file protection is part of the filesystem layer, so it doesn’t apply when you <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#disable-filesystem-isolation">disable filesystem isolation</a>; the environment variable protection still does. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="invalid-credential-entries-in-managed-settings"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#invalid-credential-entries-in-managed-settings">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Invalid credential entries in managed settings</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">When a managed <code>sandbox.credentials</code> entry fails validation, Claude Code keeps protecting the credential where it can:</span>
<ul>
<li>An entry in <code>files</code> or <code>envVars</code> that still has a valid <code>path</code> or <code>name</code> and a <code>mode</code> of <code>mask</code> or <code>deny</code>, such as one whose <code>extract</code> pattern has no capturing group, is degraded to <code>mode: "deny"</code> with a warning, so the credential stays blocked, not masked, until you fix the entry. A degraded <code>files</code> entry pins <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#disable-filesystem-isolation"><code>filesystem.disabled</code></a> like an explicit <code>deny</code> entry, and the warning notes that its read block isn’t enforced if managed settings turn filesystem isolation off.</li>
<li>An entry with an unknown <code>mode</code> or an invalid <code>path</code> or <code>name</code> is stripped.</li>
<li>Each case warns; whether an entry is degraded or stripped, the remaining valid entries are still enforced, and a wholly invalid <code>credentials</code> value is dropped while the rest of <code>sandbox</code> still applies.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Applies in v2.1.191 and later; before v2.1.221, every invalid entry was stripped. For the other managed keys with per-field handling, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#invalid-entries-in-managed-settings">Invalid entries in managed settings</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials-files"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials-files">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials.files</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Protect credential files or directories from sandboxed commands. With <code>"mode": "deny"</code>, Claude Code blocks reads of the path inside the sandbox, the same read block as <a class="link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-denyread"><code>sandbox.filesystem.denyRead</code></a>. With <code>"mode": "mask"</code>, sandboxed commands on Linux and WSL2 read a sentinel copy of the file, and the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on outbound requests to that entry’s <code>injectHosts</code>; on macOS the file is unreadable inside the sandbox instead. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later, and <code>"mode": "mask"</code> requires v2.1.221 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code drops <code>mask</code> entries from project <code>.claude/settings.json</code> and local <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with <code>path</code> and a <code>mode</code> of <code>"deny"</code> or <code>"mask"</code>, plus the optional <a class="link" href="#mask-fields-for-files">mask fields for files</a></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no credential files are protected</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This hides your AWS credentials file and masks the <code>gh</code> hosts file, substituting the real value only on requests to <code>api.github.com</code>:</span>

<span data-as="p">Paths use the same <a class="link" href="#sandbox-path-prefixes">prefixes</a> as the <code>sandbox.filesystem.*</code> settings, and Claude Code merges the arrays from every settings scope the session loads. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#protect-credentials">Protect credentials</a> covers what still applies from sources you exclude with <code>--setting-sources</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later; <code>mask</code> entries require v2.1.221 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>mask</code> substitution runs only through the sandbox proxy, so set <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-tlsterminate"><code>sandbox.network.tlsTerminate</code></a>, or <a class="link" href="#sandbox-credentials-allowplaintextinject"><code>allowPlaintextInject</code></a> for plain-HTTP test networks. <code>mask</code> applies to a single file, so list each credential file individually. Claude Code accepts but ignores the <code>mask</code> fields on a <code>deny</code> entry. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#mask-credential-files">Mask credential files</a> covers which settings sources are honored and when an entry falls back to <code>deny</code>.</span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-extract"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-onextractnomatch"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-decode"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-maskclaims"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-maskduplicates"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-files-injecthosts"></span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="mask-fields-for-files"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#mask-fields-for-files">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Mask fields for files</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">A <code>mask</code> entry accepts these optional fields. Without <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code>, Claude Code replaces the entire file content with one sentinel. On macOS with filesystem isolation on, Claude Code applies a <code>mask</code> entry as <code>deny</code> before <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code> runs; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#mask-credential-files">Mask credential files</a>.</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_304llktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Field</th><th style="text-align:left">Type</th><th style="text-align:left">What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>extract</code></td><td style="text-align:left">string, a regular expression with at least one capturing group</td><td style="text-align:left">Mask only the text captured by group 1 of each match, so the rest of the file stays parseable. With <code>decode</code> also set, Claude Code checks each capture as a possible JWT instead of replacing it outright. Requires v2.1.221 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>onExtractNoMatch</code></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>"warn"</code>, <code>"deny"</code>, or <code>"error"</code>; default <code>"warn"</code></td><td style="text-align:left">What happens when <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code> finds nothing to mask. <code>warn</code> leaves the file readable as-is inside the sandbox, <code>deny</code> makes it unreadable, and <code>error</code> stops sandbox setup until you fix the configuration. Claude Code treats <code>deny</code> as <code>error</code> when the read block wouldn’t be enforced, because you <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#disable-filesystem-isolation">disable filesystem isolation</a> or a <a class="link" href="#sandbox-filesystem-allowread"><code>sandbox.filesystem.allowRead</code></a> entry re-opens the path. Requires v2.1.221 or later; the <code>decode</code> case requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>decode</code></td><td style="text-align:left">the string <code>"jwt"</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Find JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) in the file, with a built-in pattern or with <code>extract</code> when set, verify each candidate, and replace it with a structurally valid fake token, so code inside the sandbox that decodes the token keeps working. When no candidate verifies, <code>onExtractNoMatch</code> governs the outcome. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>maskClaims</code></td><td style="text-align:left">array of strings, at least one claim name; requires <code>decode</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Mask only the named top-level payload claims inside each verified JWT and rebuild the token around the modified payload, so the other claims stay readable. When no named claim matches, <code>onExtractNoMatch</code> governs the outcome. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>maskDuplicates</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Boolean, default <code>false</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Also replace verbatim copies of each masked value elsewhere in the file, such as a secret pasted into a comment. Claude Code matches raw substrings, so reserve it for long, high-entropy secrets. Consulted only when <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code> is set. Requires v2.1.221 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>injectHosts</code></td><td style="text-align:left">array of strings, each a host that <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-alloweddomains"><code>sandbox.network.allowedDomains</code></a> also admits</td><td style="text-align:left">Narrow the hosts where the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value. When unset, the proxy substitutes it on requests to every host in <code>sandbox.network.allowedDomains</code>. Requires v2.1.221 or later</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">This masks only the <code>oauth_token</code> value in the <code>gh</code> hosts file, replaces every other copy of it in the file, makes the file unreadable if the pattern matches nothing, and substitutes the real token only on requests to <code>api.github.com</code>:</span>
<div class="code-block mt-5 mb-8 not-prose rounded-2xl relative group min-w-0 print:print-color-exact text-gray-950 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:text-gray-50 codeblock-light border <h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials-envvars"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials-envvars">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials.envVars</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Protect environment variables from sandboxed commands. With <code>"mode": "deny"</code>, Claude Code removes the variable from the environment of sandboxed commands. With <code>"mode": "mask"</code>, sandboxed commands see a per-session sentinel value, and the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on outbound requests to that entry’s <code>injectHosts</code>, so tools such as <code>gh</code> and <code>npm</code> keep authenticating without ever holding the real credential. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later, and <code>"mode": "mask"</code> requires v2.1.199 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code drops <code>mask</code> entries from project <code>.claude/settings.json</code> and local <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with <code>name</code> and a <code>mode</code> of <code>"deny"</code> or <code>"mask"</code>, plus the optional <a class="link" href="#mask-fields-for-environment-variables">mask fields for environment variables</a></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no environment variables are protected</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This removes <code>NPM_TOKEN</code> from sandboxed commands and masks <code>GITHUB_TOKEN</code>, substituting the real value only on requests to <code>api.github.com</code>:</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">The <code>name</code> must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, and underscores. Claude Code merges the arrays from every settings scope the session loads, and applies <code>deny</code> when the same variable appears with both modes. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#protect-credentials">Protect credentials</a> covers what still applies from sources you exclude with <code>--setting-sources</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.187 or later; <code>mask</code> entries require v2.1.199 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>mask</code> substitution runs only through the sandbox proxy, so set <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-tlsterminate"><code>sandbox.network.tlsTerminate</code></a>, or <a class="link" href="#sandbox-credentials-allowplaintextinject"><code>allowPlaintextInject</code></a> for plain-HTTP test networks; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#mask-environment-variables">Mask environment variables</a>. Claude Code accepts but ignores the <code>mask</code> fields on a <code>deny</code> entry.</span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-envvars-extract"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-envvars-onextractnomatch"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-envvars-decode"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-envvars-maskclaims"></span>
<span id="sandbox-credentials-envvars-injecthosts"></span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="mask-fields-for-environment-variables"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#mask-fields-for-environment-variables">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Mask fields for environment variables</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">A <code>mask</code> entry accepts these optional fields. Without <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code>, Claude Code replaces the entire value with one sentinel. <code>extract</code> and <code>decode</code> can’t be combined on the same entry.</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_34cllktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Field</th><th style="text-align:left">Type</th><th style="text-align:left">What it does</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>extract</code></td><td style="text-align:left">string, a regular expression with at least one capturing group</td><td style="text-align:left">Mask only the text captured by group 1 of each match, such as the password inside a <code>DATABASE_URL</code> connection string, so the rest of the value stays parseable. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>onExtractNoMatch</code></td><td style="text-align:left"><code>"warn"</code>, <code>"deny"</code>, or <code>"error"</code>; default <code>"warn"</code>. On an entry with <code>decode</code>, only <code>"warn"</code> is accepted</td><td style="text-align:left">What happens when <code>extract</code> matches nothing. <code>warn</code> passes the variable through unmasked, <code>deny</code> unsets it inside the sandbox, and <code>error</code> stops sandbox setup until you fix the configuration. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>decode</code></td><td style="text-align:left">the string <code>"jwt"</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Verify the whole value is a JWT and replace it with a structurally valid fake token, so code inside the sandbox that decodes the token keeps working; the proxy substitutes the whole real token on egress. A value that doesn’t verify passes through unmasked with a warning. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>maskClaims</code></td><td style="text-align:left">array of strings, at least one claim name; requires <code>decode</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Mask only the named top-level payload claims inside the decoded JWT and rebuild the token around the modified payload, so the other claims stay readable. When no named claim matches, the variable passes through unmasked with a warning. Requires v2.1.224 or later</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>injectHosts</code></td><td style="text-align:left">array of strings, each a host that <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-alloweddomains"><code>sandbox.network.allowedDomains</code></a> also admits</td><td style="text-align:left">Narrow the hosts where the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value. When unset, the proxy substitutes it on requests to every host in <code>sandbox.network.allowedDomains</code>. Write an IPv6 destination as the bare compressed address, such as <code>"::1"</code>, not the bracketed form; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#ipv6-destinations-in-injecthosts">IPv6 destinations in <code>injectHosts</code></a>. Requires v2.1.199 or later</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials-allowplaintextinject"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials-allowplaintextinject">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials.allowPlaintextInject</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Allow <code>mask</code> substitution on plain HTTP requests as well as TLS-terminated HTTPS. On plain HTTP the upstream identity is unverified and the credential travels in cleartext, so leave this off outside trusted test networks. Requires Claude Code v2.1.199 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code allows <code>mask</code> substitution on plain HTTP requests as well as TLS-terminated HTTPS</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code allows <code>mask</code> substitution only on TLS-terminated HTTPS</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>
<div class="code-block mt-5 mb-8 not-prose rounded-2xl relative group min-w-0 print:print-color-exact text-gray-950 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:text-gray-50 codeblock-light border <span data-as="p">Requires Claude Code v2.1.199 or later.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials-awspairs"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials-awspairs">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials.awsPairs</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Group masked environment variables that form one AWS credential for <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#re-sign-aws-requests">SigV4 re-signing</a> when your credential lives in variables with non-standard names. Claude Code links the conventional <code>AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID</code>, <code>AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY</code>, and <code>AWS_SESSION_TOKEN</code> trio automatically when you mask their whole values, so you need this key only for other names. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with <code>accessKeyIdVar</code>, <code>secretAccessKeyVar</code>, and optionally <code>sessionTokenVar</code>, naming <code>sandbox.credentials.envVars</code> entries</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so only the conventional trio is paired</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This links three custom-named variables into one AWS credential for re-signing:</span>

<span data-as="p">Each named variable must be a whole-value <code>mask</code> entry in <a class="link" href="#sandbox-credentials-envvars"><code>sandbox.credentials.envVars</code></a>, without <code>extract</code> or <code>decode</code>, and can fill only one slot across all pairs.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-credentials-sigv4"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-credentials-sigv4">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.credentials.sigv4</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose what the sandbox proxy does with AWS request forms it <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#re-sign-aws-requests">can’t re-sign</a>: <code>streaming</code> for aws-chunked streaming uploads, <code>presigned</code> for presigned URLs, and <code>sigv4a</code> for SigV4A asymmetric signatures. This applies only to requests signed with a masked pair’s placeholder access key ID. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>streaming</code>, <code>presigned</code>, and <code>sigv4a</code>, each one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"deny"</code>: the proxy fails the request</li>
<li><code>"passthrough"</code>: the proxy forwards the request signed with the masked placeholder, so the tool receives AWS’s own rejection</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so every form is <code>"deny"</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This forwards streaming uploads instead of failing them at the proxy:</span>

<span data-as="p">With <code>deny</code>, the proxy fails the request. With <code>passthrough</code>, the proxy forwards the request with its signature computed from the masked placeholder, so AWS rejects it and the calling tool receives AWS’s own response instead of a proxy error.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Control which hosts, ports, and sockets sandboxed commands can reach. The sandbox routes outbound traffic through a proxy that enforces these lists; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#network-isolation">Network isolation</a> for how the proxy decides and when it prompts.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. <code>strictAllowlist</code>, <code>allowManagedDomainsOnly</code>, and <code>tlsTerminate</code> are read from fewer sources, as their entries say.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with the sub-keys below</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no domains are pre-allowed and the sandbox prompts for each new host</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This pre-allows GitHub and npm, blocks <code>uploads.github.com</code>, and lets commands bind to localhost:</span>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code merges the array sub-keys across settings scopes and deduplicates them, so a project can add domains to your user list. <code>WebFetch(domain:...)</code> allow and deny <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#permission-rules">permission rules</a> feed the same allow and deny lists.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network-allowunixsockets"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network-allowunixsockets">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">List the Unix socket paths sandboxed commands can connect to on macOS. Claude Code ignores this list on Linux and WSL2, where the seccomp filter can’t inspect socket paths; use <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-allowallunixsockets"><code>allowAllUnixSockets</code></a> there instead.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, each a socket path</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the macOS sandbox blocks every Unix socket</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">A socket path can grant broad access: allowing <code>/var/run/docker.sock</code>, for example, lets a sandboxed command control the Docker daemon. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#security-limitations">Security limitations</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network-allowallunixsockets"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network-allowallunixsockets">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network.allowAllUnixSockets</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Let sandboxed commands connect to every Unix socket. On Linux and WSL2, the sandbox’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#set-up-linux-and-wsl2">seccomp filter</a> blocks <code>socket(AF_UNIX, ...)</code> calls, so this is the only way to permit Unix sockets there. When the filter is missing, which <code>/sandbox</code> reports on its Dependencies tab, the sandbox doesn’t block Unix-socket calls. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#set-up-linux-and-wsl2">Set up Linux and WSL2</a> for where the filter comes from.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: sandboxed commands can connect to every Unix socket</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the sandbox blocks Unix-socket connections: on macOS except the paths in <code>allowUnixSockets</code>, and on Linux and WSL2 through the seccomp filter when it’s present</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Let sandboxed commands bind to localhost ports on macOS, for example to start a dev server.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: sandboxed commands can bind to localhost ports on macOS</li>
<li><code>false</code>: sandboxed commands on macOS can’t bind to localhost ports</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">List additional XPC and Mach service names the macOS sandbox may look up. Tools that communicate over XPC, such as the iOS Simulator or Playwright, need their services listed here.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, each a service name; a single trailing <code>*</code> matches a prefix, and <code>"*"</code> alone matches every service</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This allows every service under the <code>com.apple.coresimulator.</code> prefix:</span>

<span data-as="p">Pre-allow domains for outbound traffic from sandboxed commands, so the sandbox doesn’t prompt for them. Wildcards such as <code>*.example.com</code> match subdomains, and an optional <code>:port</code> suffix limits an entry to one port; an entry without a port matches every port.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Only managed settings when <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-allowmanageddomainsonly"><code>allowManagedDomainsOnly</code></a> is set.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional <code>:port</code> suffix</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the sandbox prompts the first time a command reaches a new host</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This pre-allows GitHub on every port, every npm subdomain, and one API host on port 443 only:</span>

<span data-as="p">Write IPv6 literals bracketed, with an optional port: <code>"[::1]"</code> allows every port and <code>"[::1]:443"</code> one port. The bracketed form requires Claude Code v2.1.229 or later. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#ipv6-addresses-in-domain-lists">IPv6 addresses in domain lists</a>.</span>

<span data-as="p">Block domains for outbound traffic from sandboxed commands, using the same wildcard, port, and IPv6 syntax as <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-alloweddomains"><code>allowedDomains</code></a>. A denied domain stays blocked even when an <code>allowedDomains</code> entry matches it too.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional <code>:port</code> suffix</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code merges this list from every settings source the session loads even when <code>allowManagedDomainsOnly</code> is set, so a developer can always tighten the deny list. For IPv6 literals, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#ipv6-addresses-in-domain-lists">IPv6 addresses in domain lists</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">An entry written with the trailing dot that marks a fully qualified domain name, such as <code>example.com.</code>, blocks the same connections as <code>example.com</code>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network-strictallowlist"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network-strictallowlist">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network.strictAllowlist</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Deny sandboxed commands access to hosts outside the allowlist instead of prompting for approval. The allowlist is <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-alloweddomains"><code>allowedDomains</code></a> plus domains from <code>WebFetch(domain:...)</code> allow rules, or only the managed settings entries when <a class="link" href="#sandbox-network-allowmanageddomainsonly"><code>allowManagedDomainsOnly</code></a> is set. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. A repository can’t turn it on or off.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code denies sandboxed commands access to hosts outside the allowlist</li>
<li><code>false</code>: unless another trusted settings file sets <code>true</code>, Claude Code decides a host outside the allowlist by permission mode instead of denying it outright: it runs the classifier in auto mode, denies in <code>dontAsk</code> mode, allows in <code>bypassPermissions</code> mode and in plan mode when bypass is available, and otherwise asks you</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code enforces this for sandboxed commands only; in-process tools such as <code>WebFetch</code> still follow their <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#permission-rules">permission rules</a>. When any of the honored sources sets it to <code>true</code>, it stays on. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#network-isolation">Network isolation</a>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network-allowmanageddomainsonly"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network-allowmanageddomainsonly">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Lock the network allowlist to what managed settings define. Claude Code then honors only <code>allowedDomains</code> and <code>WebFetch(domain:...)</code> allow rules from managed settings, ignores domains from user, project, local, and <code>--settings</code> settings, and blocks a non-allowed domain automatically instead of prompting.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code honors only <code>allowedDomains</code> and <code>WebFetch(domain:...)</code> allow rules from managed settings and blocks a non-allowed domain instead of prompting</li>
<li><code>false</code>: domains from user, project, local, and <code>--settings</code> settings merge into the allowlist</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This locks the allowlist to GitHub and npm and ignores any domains developers add:</span>

<span data-as="p">Point the sandbox at your own HTTP proxy instead of the one Claude Code runs. Organizations do this to inspect HTTPS traffic, apply their own filtering rules, or log every request. When unset, Claude Code starts its own proxy for HTTP traffic.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: number, a local TCP port</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy</li>
</ul>

<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sandbox-network-tlsterminate"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sandbox-network-tlsterminate">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sandbox.network.tlsTerminate</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Make the sandbox proxy terminate TLS so it can read the contents of HTTPS requests. This is experimental, and <code>mask</code> <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sandboxing#mask-credentials">credential substitution</a> requires it. Set <code>{}</code> to generate an ephemeral certificate authority for the session, or set <code>caCertPath</code> and <code>caKeyPath</code> to use your own.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. A repository can’t switch it on or supply a certificate authority.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with optional <code>caCertPath</code> and <code>caKeyPath</code> strings, each a file path</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the proxy doesn’t terminate or inspect TLS</li>
</ul>
