<span data-as="p">When more than one honored source sets it, Claude Code uses the value from the highest-precedence source: managed settings, then the <code>--settings</code> flag, then user settings. Requires Claude Code v2.1.199 or later.</span>
<span id="context-and-memory"></span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="memory-and-context"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#memory-and-context">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Memory and context</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Control what Claude Code loads into context, how it compacts, and where it keeps memory and plans. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/context-window">Manage context</a> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory">Memory</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="autocompactenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#autocompactenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>autoCompactEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Have Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/context-window#when-your-context-fills-up">compact the conversation automatically</a> when context approaches the limit. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Auto-compact</strong>, and toggling it there writes this key to your user settings.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code compacts the conversation automatically when context approaches the limit</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code doesn’t compact automatically</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT</code></a> turns auto-compact off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can’t turn it back on</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="autocompactwindow"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#autocompactwindow">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>autoCompactWindow</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set how full the context window gets before Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/context-window#when-your-context-fills-up">compacts automatically</a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: number of tokens, from <code>100000</code> to <code>1000000</code>. Claude Code caps the value at your model’s context window; the <a class="link" href="https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">models overview</a> lists each model’s window</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code picks a window tuned for your model</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags"><code>--autocompact</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session, and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW</code></a> takes precedence over both</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Store <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory#storage-location">auto memory</a> in a directory of your choice instead of the per-project default.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, an absolute or <code>~/</code>-prefixed directory path</li>

</ul>

<span data-as="p">Turn <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory#enable-or-disable-auto-memory">auto memory</a> on or off. When <code>false</code>, Claude doesn’t read from or write to the auto memory directory. You can also toggle it with <code>/memory</code> during a session, which writes this key to your user settings.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the same as unset; auto memory stays on unless something that outranks this key turns it off for the session, such as <code>--bare</code>, safe mode, or <code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY</code></li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude doesn’t read from or write to the auto memory directory</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Set how many characters of a successful Bash or PowerShell command’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#output-limits">output Claude receives inline</a>. When output passes the limit, Claude Code saves it to a file and Claude receives a short preview plus the file’s path. Raise the limit when command output, such as a verbose build or a full test-suite log, routinely overflows the default and you want Claude to read it without opening the file. Requires Claude Code v2.1.261 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: number of characters, a positive integer. Claude Code clamps the value into the range <code>4000</code> to <code>128000</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude receives up to 30,000 characters inline</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Inject CLAUDE.md-style instructions as organization-managed memory without deploying a separate file. Claude Code loads the text as a managed memory entry ahead of user and project CLAUDE.md files.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, the text of a CLAUDE.md file; write it as you would the file, Markdown included, with line breaks as <code>\n</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example deploys two rules as a short Markdown list:</span>

<span data-as="p">Skip specific <code>CLAUDE.md</code> files when Claude Code loads <a class="link" href="/docs/en/memory#exclude-specific-claude-md-files">memory</a>. In a large monorepo, use it to skip CLAUDE.md files from other teams that aren’t relevant to your work; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/large-codebases#exclude-irrelevant-claude-md-files">Exclude irrelevant CLAUDE.md files</a> in the large-codebases guide walks through that case. Patterns match against absolute file paths.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, each a glob pattern or absolute path</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code loads every CLAUDE.md it finds</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Exclusions apply only to user, project, and local memory files; managed policy CLAUDE.md files can’t be excluded.</span>
<span id="environment-variables"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="env"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#env">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>env</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set environment variables for every session and for the subprocesses Claude Code starts from it. Any variable in the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars">environment variables reference</a> can go here, which is how you apply one to every session or roll it out to your team.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object mapping variable names to string values</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="how-env-values-interact-with-your-shell"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#how-env-values-interact-with-your-shell">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">How <code>env</code> values interact with your shell</span></h4>
<ul>
<li>A value here overwrites the same variable exported in your shell, and when more than one settings file sets a variable, the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings#settings-precedence">highest-precedence</a> one applies.</li>
<li>To cancel a shell export, set the variable to <code>""</code>. Claude Code treats an empty value as unset for provider selection, and subprocesses inherit the empty value.</li>
<li><code>NO_COLOR</code> and <code>FORCE_COLOR</code> set here reach only subprocesses. To change Claude Code’s own interface colors, set them in your shell before launching <code>claude</code>.</li>
<li>Values here are plain text in the settings file and reach every subprocess Claude Code starts. For an OTLP bearer token that rotates, use <a class="link" href="#otelheadershelper"><code>otelHeadersHelper</code></a>; for API credentials, use <a class="link" href="#apikeyhelper"><code>apiKeyHelper</code></a>.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="when-claude-code-applies-env-values"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#when-claude-code-applies-env-values">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">When Claude Code applies <code>env</code> values</span></h4>
<ul>
<li>From user settings, <code>--settings</code>, and managed settings: at startup, and again in the running session when a saved change alters the merged <code>env</code>.</li>
<li>From project and local settings: after you trust the workspace, or at startup in <code>-p</code> mode, which never shows the trust dialog, and again when a saved change alters the merged <code>env</code>.</li>
<li>Variables Claude Code classifies as safe, such as model selection, timeouts and limits, feature toggles, and telemetry settings: at startup from every settings file, apart from the <a class="link" href="#variables-claude-code-ignores-in-env">variables project and local settings can’t set</a>.</li>
<li>After you <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permissions#move-the-session-to-another-directory">move the session with <code>/cd</code></a> on v2.1.246 or later: the new directory’s project and local <code>env</code> values, on top of the previous directory’s.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="variables-claude-code-ignores-in-env"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#variables-claude-code-ignores-in-env">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Variables Claude Code ignores in <code>env</code></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>
<span data-as="p">Project and local settings can’t set variables that a checked-out repository shouldn’t control; set those in your shell, user settings, or managed settings instead. Claude Code drops each one and logs a warning you can see with <code>claude --debug</code>. They include:</span>
<ul>
<li>Variables that choose where Claude Code stores or writes its own files: <code>CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR</code>, <code>CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR</code>, and the operating-system directory variables such as <code>HOME</code>, <code>TMPDIR</code>, <code>TMP</code>, <code>TEMP</code>, and the <code>XDG_*</code> family.</li>
<li>Variables that export session content: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars#variables"><code>OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES</code></a> and the detailed beta tracing pair <code>ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED</code> and <code>BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT</code>.</li>
<li>Variables that change how Claude Code starts or syncs, such as <code>CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER</code>, <code>CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS</code>, <code>CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGINS</code>, <code>CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR</code>, and <code>CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR</code>.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Before v2.1.251, project and local settings could set every variable this list names except <code>HOME</code>, <code>XDG_CONFIG_HOME</code>, and the variables that change how Claude Code starts or syncs.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p">Identity variables that Claude Code’s hosting environments own, such as <code>CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE</code> and <code>CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID</code>, are ignored from every file.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars#variables"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET</code> and <code>CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN</code></a>, which Claude Code exports itself, are ignored from every file. Ignoring the socket variable requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later, and ignoring the token requires v2.1.228 or later.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/sessions#name-the-project-directory-yourself"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME</code></a>, which Claude Code reads from the launch environment only, is ignored from every file; requires v2.1.234 or later.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars#variables"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED</code></a>, which Claude Code reads from the launch environment only, is ignored from every file.</span>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="filecheckpointingenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#filecheckpointingenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>fileCheckpointingEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Have Claude Code snapshot files before each edit so <a class="link" href="/docs/en/checkpointing"><code>/rewind</code></a> can restore them. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Rewind code (checkpoints)</strong>, and toggling it there writes this key to your user settings.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code snapshots files before each edit so <code>/rewind</code> can restore them</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code doesn’t snapshot files, so <code>/rewind</code> can’t restore them</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING</code></a> turns checkpointing off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can’t turn it back on</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Choose where Claude Code stores the plan files it writes in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes#analyze-before-you-edit-with-plan-mode">plan mode</a>. Claude Code resolves the path relative to the project root and keeps the default when the path resolves outside it.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a path relative to the project root</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses <code>~/.claude/plans</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Each turn, Claude sees a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/skills#skill-descriptions-are-cut-short">listing of your skills</a> with their descriptions, and Claude Code caps that listing at a share of the context window. When the listing is over the cap, Claude Code keeps every skill’s name but drops the descriptions of the least-used skills, so Claude can still invoke those skills but is less likely to choose one on its own. Raise this key to keep more descriptions visible at the cost of more context per turn.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: number, a fraction greater than <code>0</code> and at most <code>1</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>0.01</code>, which reserves 1% of the context window</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="taskoutputmaxchars"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#taskoutputmaxchars">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>taskOutputMaxChars</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set how many characters of a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#background-commands">background task’s</a> output Claude receives inline when Claude reads the task with the <code>TaskOutput</code> tool. When a finished task’s output is longer, Claude receives the most recent characters. Raise the limit when your background tasks routinely produce more output than the default. Requires Claude Code v2.1.261 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: number of characters, a positive integer. Claude Code clamps the value into the range <code>4000</code> to <code>128000</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude receives up to 32,000 characters inline</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="askuserquestiontimeout"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#askuserquestiontimeout">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>askUserQuestionTimeout</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Let an unanswered <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference"><code>AskUserQuestion</code></a> dialog auto-continue after a period of idle time, submitting whatever options you had already selected. Set it when you step away and want Claude to continue without you. With the default, questions wait until you answer them. Requires Claude Code v2.1.200 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of <code>"60s"</code>, <code>"5m"</code>, <code>"10m"</code>, or <code>"never"</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"never"</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">After a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, wait in the open session and continue the task automatically after the reset. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#turn-automatic-continue-off">Turn automatic continue off</a>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.234 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. Read from user settings, <code>--settings</code>, and managed settings only. When none of those sets the key, a project or local settings file that sets it turns the feature off rather than being ignored.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: after a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, Claude Code waits in the open session and continues the task automatically after the reset</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code doesn’t start the wait on its own. You can still <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#start-a-wait-yourself">start a wait yourself</a> from the usage-limit options menu</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="axscreenreader"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#axscreenreader">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>axScreenReader</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Render screen-reader friendly output: flat text without decorative borders or animations. Screen-reader mode uses the classic renderer, so the <code>tui</code> setting has no effect while it is active; attached <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-view">background sessions</a> still render fullscreen. Requires Claude Code v2.1.181 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code renders flat text without decorative borders or animations, using the classic renderer</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code renders normally</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so screen-reader mode is off</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags"><code>--ax-screen-reader</code></a> takes precedence over <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER</code></a>, and both take precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="defaultshell"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#defaultshell">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>defaultShell</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose whether Bash or PowerShell runs the shell commands you type with the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#shell-mode-with-prefix"><code>!</code> prefix</a> in the input box, the ones Claude Code runs directly and adds to the session.</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>"powershell"</code> works only while the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool">PowerShell tool</a> is on. The tool is on by default on Windows without Git Bash, and on Windows with Git Bash for claude.ai and Console accounts. In Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry sessions, and on macOS, Linux, and WSL, set <code>CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1</code> to turn the tool on. Set that variable to <code>0</code> to turn the tool off.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"bash"</code>: Claude Code runs your <code>!</code> commands in Bash</li>
<li><code>"powershell"</code>: Claude Code runs your <code>!</code> commands in PowerShell</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"bash"</code>, or <code>"powershell"</code> on Windows when Bash isn’t available</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="dialogexpiry"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#dialogexpiry">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>dialogExpiry</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set the deadline for dialogs Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control#limitations">forwards to a remote client</a>, such as a Remote Control or SDK host, and for the approval dialog for a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cross-session-messaging#control-inbound-messages">held cross-session message</a>. On Claude Code v2.1.236 or later, the same deadline bounds the mid-session <a class="link" href="/docs/en/model-config#fable-and-usage-credits">Fable usage-credits consent prompt</a> in a session that may have nobody at the terminal. When no answer arrives before the deadline, Claude Code cancels the dialog and continues with its no-action default. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of <code>"60s"</code>, <code>"5m"</code>, <code>"10m"</code>, or <code>"never"</code>, which disables the deadline</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"5m"</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Permission prompts and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/tools-reference#askuserquestion-tool-behavior"><code>AskUserQuestion</code></a> questions use their own flows and aren’t governed by this deadline. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Dialog expiry</strong>, which writes this key to user settings; the row requires Claude Code v2.1.232 or later, and Claude Code hides it while managed settings or the <code>--settings</code> flag set the key.</span>

<span data-as="p">Choose the key binding mode for the input prompt.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"normal"</code>: standard key bindings in the prompt input</li>
<li><code>"vim"</code>: vim-style editing with NORMAL, INSERT, and VISUAL modes</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"normal"</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Show emoji suggestions when you type <code>:</code> plus a shortcode in the prompt input, and replace a completed shortcode such as <code>:heart:</code> with its emoji. Set it to <code>false</code> to turn off both.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code shows emoji suggestions after <code>:</code> and replaces a completed shortcode with its emoji</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code neither suggests emoji nor replaces shortcodes</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Run your own command to supply <code>@</code> file path autocomplete instead of the built-in file suggestion. The built-in suggestion uses fast filesystem traversal; a large monorepo may do better with project-specific indexing such as a pre-built file index.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Under the <a class="link" href="#status-line-and-file-suggestion-gates">status line and file suggestion gates</a>, Claude Code turns the command off or runs only a managed value, and skips yours without warning.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>type</code>, always <code>"command"</code>, and <code>command</code>, the shell command to run</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in file suggestion</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">After you save this, type <code>@</code> followed by part of a path in the prompt: the suggestions come from your command’s output.</span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="footerlinksregexes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#footerlinksregexes">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>footerLinksRegexes</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Render extra clickable badges in the footer below the input box when a regex matches turn output: tool results, including file contents and fetched pages, and Claude’s own responses. Use it to turn IDs printed by project CLIs, such as review tools and issue trackers, into session links. Requires Claude Code v2.1.176 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with <code>type</code> set to <code>"regex"</code>, a <code>pattern</code> regex, a <code>url</code> template, and an optional <code>label</code>; <code>{name}</code> placeholders in <code>url</code> and <code>label</code> are filled from named capture groups in <code>pattern</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no badges render</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">With this configured, when <code>PROJ-1234</code> appears in a tool result or in Claude’s reply, a <code>PROJ-1234</code> badge appears in the footer linking to <code>https://issues.example.com/browse/PROJ-1234</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.176 or later.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="badge-constraints"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#badge-constraints">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Badge constraints</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Each entry’s URL, label, and badge count are bounded as follows:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_4ssllktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Constraint</th><th style="text-align:left">Behavior</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left">URL origin</td><td style="text-align:left">Captured values are URL-encoded and the constructed URL must share the template’s literal origin. A capture can fill a path segment or query value but can’t change where the link points</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">URL length</td><td style="text-align:left">Constructed URLs longer than 2048 characters are dropped</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">URL scheme</td><td style="text-align:left">Must be <code>https</code>, <code>http</code>, or a recognized editor or workspace deep-link scheme: <code>vscode</code>, <code>vscode-insiders</code>, <code>cursor</code>, <code>windsurf</code>, <code>zed</code>, <code>jetbrains</code>, <code>idea</code>, <code>slack</code>, <code>linear</code>, <code>notion</code>, <code>figma</code></td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">Label</td><td style="text-align:left">Defaults to the matched text and is truncated to 28 display columns</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left">Badge count</td><td style="text-align:left">At most 5 badges render. The oldest is displaced by newer matches and <code>/clear</code> removes them</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">When a turn completes, Claude Code matches each entry’s <code>pattern</code> regex against the turn output on the main thread, so a slow regex blocks the UI until it finishes. Nested quantifiers such as <code>(a+)+$</code> can take exponentially long against certain inputs and freeze the session, so keep each <code>pattern</code> linear and avoid nesting <code>+</code> or <code>*</code>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Footer badges render alongside a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline">custom status line</a> when one is configured; neither replaces the other. Use a status line for a script-driven row that computes its own content from session data, and footer badges to turn IDs from the conversation into links without a script.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="keybindingflavor"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#keybindingflavor">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>keybindingFlavor</code></span></h3>
<div aria-label="Warning" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part='callout-icon']]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M 9 6.75 v 1.5 m 0 3 h 0.0075 m -5.2035 3 h 10.392 c 1.155 0 1.8765 -1.2503 1.299 -2.25 L 10.299 3 c -0.5775 -0.9997 -2.0205 -0.9997 -2.598 0 L 2.505 12 c -0.5775 0.9997 0.144 2.25 1.299 2.25 z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Deprecated since v2.1.261 and has no effect. The prompt’s word-editing keys always <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#make-ctrl-w-delete-back-to-whitespace">follow readline conventions</a>, as in Bash. Claude Code still accepts <code>keybindingFlavor</code>, so a settings file that sets it stays valid.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">In v2.1.238 through v2.1.260, setting it to <code>"readline"</code> made <code>Ctrl+W</code> delete back to the previous whitespace instead of only the previous word.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, <code>"classic"</code> or <code>"readline"</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Reduce or turn off interface animations such as the spinner, shimmer, and flash effects. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Reduce motion</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code reduces or turns off interface animations such as the spinner, shimmer, and flash effects</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the same as unset; Claude Code shows its animations</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Show or hide <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#prompt-suggestions">prompt suggestions</a>, the grayed-out predictions that appear in your prompt input. Set it to <code>false</code>, or turn off <strong>Prompt suggestions</strong> in <code>/config</code>, to hide them.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see prompt suggestions in your prompt input</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code hides prompt suggestions</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Prompt suggestions need a claude.ai or Console account with telemetry on. On Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry, or with telemetry turned off, such as by <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>DISABLE_TELEMETRY</code></a>, this key has no effect and only <code>CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=1</code> turns them on.</span>

<span data-as="p">Control whether the <code>@</code> file picker leaves out files that match <code>.gitignore</code> patterns. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Respect .gitignore in file picker</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. When no settings file sets it, Claude Code falls back to <code>respectGitignore</code> in <code>~/.claude.json</code>, which the <code>/config</code> toggle writes.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the <code>@</code> file picker leaves out files that match <code>.gitignore</code> patterns</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the <code>@</code> file picker includes files that match <code>.gitignore</code> patterns</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="respondtobashcommands"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#respondtobashcommands">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>respondToBashCommands</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose whether Claude responds after you run a shell command with the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#shell-mode-with-prefix"><code>!</code> prefix</a> in the input box. By default, Claude Code adds the command’s output to the conversation and Claude replies to it. Set this key to <code>false</code> to add the output to context without a reply, so you can run several commands and ask about them together. Requires Claude Code v2.1.186 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code adds the command’s output to the conversation and Claude replies to it</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code adds the output to context without a reply</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">When Claude finishes a plan in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes#review-and-approve-a-plan">plan mode</a>, it shows an approval menu. Planning can use a lot of context, so this key adds a first option to that menu, <strong>Yes, clear context and …</strong>, that approves the plan, clears the conversation context, and starts implementing from the plan alone. The rest of the label names the permission mode the session continues in, and shows how much of your context the planning used.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the plan approval menu gets a first option, <strong>Yes, clear context and …</strong>, that approves the plan and clears the conversation context</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the plan approval menu shows no clear-context option</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Show or hide the turn duration message after each response, such as “Cooked for 1m 6s · done 6:05 PM”. The clock after “done” shows when the turn finished; <a class="link" href="#timeformat"><code>timeFormat</code></a> and <a class="link" href="#timezone"><code>timeZone</code></a> control its format and zone. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Show turn duration</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A value in <code>~/.claude.json</code> from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see the turn duration message after each response</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code hides the turn duration message</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="spellcheck"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#spellcheck">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>spellcheck</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Underline misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using a spell checker you install. Claude Code checks only the text in the input box. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#check-spelling-as-you-type">Check spelling as you type</a> covers installing aspell, hunspell, or ispell and what the checker covers. Requires Claude Code v2.1.235 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. The block from the highest tier that sets it applies as a whole.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>enabled</code> (Boolean), <code>checker</code> (<code>"aspell"</code>, <code>"hunspell"</code>, <code>"ispell"</code>, or <code>"auto"</code>), <code>language</code> (string, passed to the checker as its dictionary name), and <code>color</code> (string, a terminal color name, <code>#rrggbb</code>, <code>rgb(r,g,b)</code>, <code>ansi256(n)</code>, or <code>ansi:&lt;name&gt;</code>)</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so spell checking is off; <code>checker</code> defaults to <code>"auto"</code>, the first of the three found on <code>PATH</code>; <code>language</code> defaults to the checker’s own dictionary; <code>color</code> defaults to the theme’s error color</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">While Claude works, the spinner line rotates through short tips about Claude Code features, such as “Use Plan Mode to prepare for a complex request before making changes. Press Shift+Tab twice to enable.” Set this key to <code>false</code> to hide them. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Show tips</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see tips in the spinner while Claude is working</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code hides spinner tips</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="spinnertipsoverride"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#spinnertipsoverride">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>spinnerTipsOverride</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Add your own tips to the <a class="link" href="#spinnertipsenabled">spinner tips</a> that Claude Code shows while Claude works, or replace the built-in tips with yours. Claude Code puts your tips in the same rotation as the built-in ones: it picks the tip that has gone unshown the longest, skips tips still in their cooldown, and breaks ties by priority.</span>
<span data-as="p">If you set <a class="link" href="#spinnertipsenabled"><code>spinnerTipsEnabled</code></a> to <code>false</code>, Claude Code hides all tips, yours included.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code honors tip objects, <code>tipsFile</code>, <code>label</code>, and <code>excludeDefault</code> from user settings, the <code>--settings</code> flag, and managed settings; from project and local settings it reads plain string tips only.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>tips</code>, <code>tipsFile</code>, <code>label</code>, and <code>excludeDefault</code> fields, each optional</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code shows only the built-in tips</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Tip objects, <code>tipsFile</code>, <code>label</code>, and the Scope line’s rule that project and local settings contribute plain strings only require Claude Code v2.1.247 or later. On earlier versions, a project or local file’s <code>excludeDefault</code> applies too.</span>
<span data-as="p">Each <code>tips</code> entry is a plain string or an object with these fields:</span>
<!-- --><div class="min-w-0 [--page-padding:20px] flex w-[calc(100%+(var(--page-padding)*2))] my-[1em] py-[1em] -mx-(--page-padding) max-w-none [contain:inline-size]" data-component-part="scroll-area" data-table-wrapper="true" role="presentation" style="position:relative;--scroll-area-corner-height:0px;--scroll-area-corner-width:0px"><div aria-label="Scrollable table" class="size-full rounded-[inherit] [--scroll-area-fade-size:32px] overflow-y-hidden! base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_58kllktbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left">Field</th><th style="text-align:left">Required</th><th style="text-align:left">Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>id</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Yes</td><td style="text-align:left">Up to 64 letters, digits, <code>.</code>, <code>_</code>, or <code>-</code>. Claude Code keys the tip’s show history on it, so the tip’s cooldown survives reordering the list. Of two entries with the same id, Claude Code uses the first</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>text</code></td><td style="text-align:left">Yes</td><td style="text-align:left">The tip, one line of up to 500 characters. Claude Code strips ANSI escapes and control characters and collapses whitespace</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>cooldownSessions</code></td><td style="text-align:left">No</td><td style="text-align:left">Sessions Claude Code waits before showing the tip again, <code>0</code> to <code>1000</code>, default <code>0</code></td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left"><code>priority</code></td><td style="text-align:left">No</td><td style="text-align:left">Order among tips that have gone unshown equally long, higher first, <code>-10</code> to <code>10</code>, default <code>0</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code reads a plain string as a tip with those defaults and a position-based id, so its show history resets when you reorder the list. Give a tip an <code>id</code> to keep its history across edits.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code reads at most 200 tips across <code>tips</code> and <code>tipsFile</code>, and drops an invalid entry with a debug warning instead of rejecting the settings file.</span>
<span data-as="p">Use the remaining fields to name a tips file, set the prefix, and hide the built-in tips:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>tipsFile</code>: an absolute or <code>~/</code> path to a local JSON file holding an array of the same entries, or an object with a <code>tips</code> array, up to 256 KB. Claude Code reads the file once per process, so it loads your edits at the next start. You can’t set it through <a class="link" href="/docs/en/server-managed-settings">server-managed settings</a>; deploy inline <code>tips</code> there, or deploy the path in an on-disk <code>managed-settings.json</code>.</li>
<li><code>label</code>: the prefix Claude Code shows before tips from user, <code>--settings</code>, and managed settings, up to 40 characters. The default is <code>Tip</code>, the same prefix as the built-in tips, and tips from project and local settings always use it.</li>
<li><code>excludeDefault</code>: set it to <code>true</code> to hide the built-in tips and show only yours. When Claude Code can’t load any of your tips, for example because <code>tipsFile</code> doesn’t exist or every entry is invalid, it keeps the built-in rotation instead of an empty spinner.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">When more than one settings file sets the key, Claude Code shows tips from all of them and takes <code>tipsFile</code>, <code>label</code>, and <code>excludeDefault</code> from whichever of managed settings, the <code>--settings</code> flag, and user settings is the highest-precedence one that sets each.</span>
<span data-as="p">This example, in your user settings, adds a plain string tip and an object tip to the rotation under the <code>Acme tip</code> prefix:</span>

<span data-as="p">Each field in the example changes one thing about how Claude Code shows the tips:</span>
<ul>
<li><code>label</code>: Claude Code shows both tips as <code>Acme tip: ...</code> instead of <code>Tip: ...</code>.</li>
<li>The plain string: Claude Code gives it the defaults, so it can come up again in the very next session.</li>
<li><code>id</code>: Claude Code keys the second tip’s show history on <code>gateway-errors</code>, so its cooldown still applies after you add or reorder tips.</li>
<li><code>cooldownSessions</code>: after Claude Code shows the <code>gateway-errors</code> tip, it doesn’t show that tip again until five sessions later.</li>
<li><code>priority</code>: when the <code>gateway-errors</code> tip and another tip have gone unshown for the same number of sessions, for example when neither has been shown yet, Claude Code shows <code>gateway-errors</code> first. The plain string has the default priority, <code>0</code>.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">While Claude works, Claude Code shows your tips in the spinner with your prefix, such as <code>Acme tip: Run /review before opening a PR</code>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="spinnerverbs"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#spinnerverbs">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>spinnerVerbs</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">While a turn is in progress, the spinner shows a rotating verb such as “Accomplishing”, “Architecting”, or “Baking”. Use this key to add your own verbs to that rotation or replace the built-in list with yours.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with a <code>verbs</code> array of strings and <code>mode</code>, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"append"</code>: Claude Code adds your verbs to the built-in set</li>
<li><code>"replace"</code>: Claude Code shows only your verbs</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in verbs</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Run your own command to render a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline">status line</a> below the prompt with context such as the model, cost, or git branch. Optional fields adjust spacing, add periodic re-runs, and hide the built-in vim mode indicator when your script renders <code>vim.mode</code> itself.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. When <a class="link" href="#allowmanagedhooksonly"><code>allowManagedHooksOnly</code></a> is on, or <a class="link" href="#disableallhooks"><code>disableAllHooks</code></a> is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>type</code> set to <code>"command"</code> and a <code>command</code> string, plus optional <code>padding</code> as a number of characters, <code>refreshInterval</code> as a number of seconds, minimum <code>1</code>, and <code>hideVimModeIndicator</code> as a Boolean</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no status line</li>
</ul>
