<span data-as="p">The example needs <a class="link" href="https://jqlang.org/" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank"><code>jq</code></a> installed and runs in a shell. For PowerShell and Git Bash equivalents, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline#windows-configuration">Windows configuration</a>; for the full setup, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline#manually-configure-a-status-line">Manually configure a status line</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="subagentstatusline"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#subagentstatusline">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>subagentStatusLine</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">When Claude runs <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents">subagents</a>, Claude Code lists them in a task display below the prompt, one row per subagent showing <code>name · description · token count</code>. This key lets you run your own command to rewrite those rows, for example to show each subagent’s context usage as a percentage. On each refresh, Claude Code sends the visible rows as one JSON object on stdin, with a <code>tasks</code> array carrying each subagent’s <code>id</code>, <code>name</code>, <code>status</code>, <code>model</code>, <code>tokenCount</code>, and more, and replaces the row for each <code>id</code> you write back as a <code>{"id", "content"}</code> line. Rows you don’t write back keep the default rendering.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. When <a class="link" href="#allowmanagedhooksonly"><code>allowManagedHooksOnly</code></a> is on, or <a class="link" href="#disableallhooks"><code>disableAllHooks</code></a> is set outside managed settings, only the managed settings value runs.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>type</code> set to <code>"command"</code> and a <code>command</code> string</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code renders the default rows</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="syntaxhighlightingdisabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#syntaxhighlightingdisabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>syntaxHighlightingDisabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code colors code by language in the diffs, code blocks, and file previews it shows in the terminal, with its built-in highlighter; no plugin or language server is involved. Set this key to <code>true</code> to show them as plain text instead, for example if the colors clash with your terminal theme or slow a screen reader.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns off syntax highlighting in diffs, code blocks, and file previews</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code highlights syntax</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="terminalprogressbarenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#terminalprogressbarenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>terminalProgressBarEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Some terminals can show a progress indicator on the tab or in the taskbar for the program running in them. While Claude is working, Claude Code reports an in-progress state to the terminal, so you can see from another tab or window whether the session is still busy. The indicator stays visible after the turn ends while <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#run-subagents-in-foreground-or-background">background subagents</a> or <a class="link" href="/docs/en/workflows">dynamic workflows</a> are still running, and clears once the session is idle.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code reports it only in terminals that support the indicator: ConEmu, Ghostty 1.2.0 or later, and iTerm2 3.6.6 or later. Set this key to <code>false</code> to stop Claude Code from reporting it. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Terminal progress bar</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A value in <code>~/.claude.json</code> from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code hides the terminal progress bar</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code sets your terminal tab’s title. By default it uses a title it generates from the conversation, and once you give the session a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sessions#name-your-sessions">name</a> with <code>/rename</code> or <code>--name</code>, the tab shows that name instead. Set this key to <code>false</code> to keep the generated title on the tab even after you name the session. The name itself still applies, so <code>/resume &lt;name&gt;</code> and the session picker find it.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the terminal tab title shows the session name you set</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the tab keeps the title Claude Code generates from your conversation</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="theme"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#theme">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>theme</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Pick the color theme for the interface. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Theme</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A value in <code>~/.claude.json</code> from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"auto"</code>: matches your terminal’s light or dark background</li>
<li><code>"dark"</code>: the dark theme</li>
<li><code>"light"</code>: the light theme</li>
<li><code>"dark-daltonized"</code>: the dark theme with colorblind-friendly colors</li>
<li><code>"light-daltonized"</code>: the light theme with colorblind-friendly colors</li>
<li><code>"dark-ansi"</code>: the dark theme using only your terminal’s ANSI color palette</li>
<li><code>"light-ansi"</code>: the light theme using only your terminal’s ANSI color palette</li>
<li><code>"custom:&lt;slug&gt;"</code> or <code>"custom:&lt;plugin-name&gt;:&lt;slug&gt;"</code>: a custom theme from <code>~/.claude/themes/</code> or a plugin</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"dark"</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="timeformat"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#timeformat">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>timeFormat</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose how Claude Code writes the times it shows in the interface, such as the <code>done 6:05 PM</code> at the end of each turn duration message and the timestamps in the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#transcript-viewer">transcript viewer</a>. To pick a preset, run <code>/config</code> and set <strong>Time format</strong>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.257 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"auto"</code>: the same as unset; each time keeps its built-in format, which follows your locale on the turn duration message</li>
<li><code>"12-hour"</code>: a 12-hour clock</li>
<li><code>"24-hour"</code>: a 24-hour clock</li>
<li><code>"24-hour-utc"</code>: a 24-hour clock in UTC with <code>Z</code> after the minutes, such as <code>18:05Z</code>; Claude Code ignores <a class="link" href="#timezone"><code>timeZone</code></a> for this preset</li>
<li>A strftime pattern such as <code>"%H:%M"</code>: Claude Code writes each time with the pattern. Any value that contains a <code>%</code> is a pattern, and any other value outside the presets counts as <code>"auto"</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"auto"</code></li>
</ul>

</code></pre></div></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">The same surfaces then show times such as <code>2026-09-01 18:05</code>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="timezone"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#timezone">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>timeZone</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Show the times in the interface in a time zone other than your system’s. Set it to an <a class="link" href="https://www.iana.org/time-zones" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">IANA time zone name</a>, such as <code>"UTC"</code> or <code>"Europe/Dublin"</code>. The times that <a class="link" href="#timeformat"><code>timeFormat</code></a> controls then show in this zone. If <code>timeFormat</code> is <code>"24-hour-utc"</code>, times stay in UTC and Claude Code ignores this key. <code>/config</code> has no row for this key, so set it in a settings file. Requires Claude Code v2.1.257 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, an IANA time zone name. When Claude Code doesn’t recognize the name, it uses your system time zone</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so times show in your system time zone</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="tui"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#tui">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>tui</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose the terminal UI renderer. Use <code>"fullscreen"</code> for the flicker-free <a class="link" href="/docs/en/fullscreen">alt-screen renderer</a> with virtualized scrollback, or <code>"default"</code> for the classic main-screen renderer. Running <code>/tui fullscreen</code> or <code>/tui default</code> writes this key for you.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"default"</code>: the classic main-screen renderer</li>
<li><code>"fullscreen"</code>: the flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/fullscreen#fullscreen-by-default">picks the renderer for you</a></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER</code></a> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN</code></a> take precedence over this key for one session: <code>CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1</code> turns fullscreen on, and <code>CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=0</code> or <code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1</code> turns it off; when both are set, Claude Code turns it off</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Under tmux <code>-CC</code> or over SSH to Windows, Claude Code keeps the classic renderer unless you set <code>CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1</code>. Background sessions opened from <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-view">agent view</a> always use the fullscreen renderer regardless of this setting.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="verbose"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#verbose">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>verbose</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">By default, the transcript collapses each tool call to a short summary, such as the command Claude ran and a line count of its output, and you press <code>Ctrl+O</code> to switch the whole transcript to the expanded view when you want the details. Set this key to <code>true</code> to show every tool call’s full input and output inline as it happens, which is useful when you’re debugging a hook, an MCP server, or a long shell command. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Verbose output</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A value in <code>~/.claude.json</code> from an older version applies when no settings file sets it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see full tool output</li>
<li><code>false</code>: you see truncated summaries of tool output</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags"><code>--verbose</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="#viewmode"><code>viewMode</code></a> value or a sticky <code>/focus</code> selection overrides this key every session.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="viewmode"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#viewmode">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>viewMode</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set the transcript view Claude Code starts in: <code>"default"</code>, <code>"verbose"</code>, or <code>"focus"</code>. When set, it overrides both the sticky <code>/focus</code> selection and the <a class="link" href="#verbose"><code>verbose</code></a> setting.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"default"</code>: the normal transcript with truncated tool output</li>
<li><code>"verbose"</code>: the transcript with full tool output</li>
<li><code>"focus"</code>: only your last prompt, a one-line summary of tool calls with edit diffstats, and the final response. Focus view needs the <a class="link" href="#tui">fullscreen renderer</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the <code>verbose</code> setting and your last <code>/focus</code> choice apply</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags"><code>--verbose</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Map two-key INSERT-mode sequences to Escape in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#vim-editor-mode">vim editor mode</a>. Each key is exactly two printable characters typed in sequence, and <code>"&lt;Esc&gt;"</code> is the only supported target; Claude Code ignores other entries. Requires Claude Code v2.1.208 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. A repository can’t remap your keystrokes.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object mapping a two-character sequence to <code>"&lt;Esc&gt;"</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Turn on <a class="link" href="/docs/en/voice-dictation">voice dictation</a> and choose how the dictation key behaves. Claude Code writes this object for you when you run <code>/voice</code>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>enabled</code> as a Boolean, <code>autoSubmit</code> as a Boolean that applies in hold mode only, and <code>mode</code>, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"hold"</code>: you hold the dictation key while speaking and release it to stop</li>
<li><code>"tap"</code>: you tap the key once to start recording and again to send</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so dictation is off; when <code>enabled</code> is <code>true</code> and <code>mode</code> is unset, Claude Code uses <code>"hold"</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example turns dictation on and makes the key tap once to start recording and again to send:</span>

[&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Deprecated since v2.1.92, when the <a class="link" href="#voice"><code>voice</code></a> object replaced it. <span data-as="p">Turn voice dictation on with the single Boolean form that predates the <code>voice</code> object. When both are set, <code>voice.enabled</code> applies.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: voice dictation is on when you’re logged in with a claude.ai account and your organization’s policy allows voice, unless <code>voice.enabled</code> is set</li>
<li><code>false</code>: voice dictation is off, unless <code>voice.enabled</code> is set</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Accelerate mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/fullscreen#mouse-wheel-scrolling">fullscreen rendering</a>. Set it to <code>false</code> for a constant scroll rate per wheel notch. Requires Claude Code v2.1.174 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code accelerates mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code scrolls at a constant rate per wheel notch</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="git-and-attribution"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#git-and-attribution">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Git and attribution</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Control the attribution Claude Code adds to commits and pull requests and how it works with git.</span>
<span id="attribution-settings"></span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="attribution"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#attribution">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>attribution</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Customize the attribution Claude Code adds to git commits and pull requests. Commits get a <a class="link" href="https://git-scm.com/docs/git-interpret-trailers" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">git trailer</a> such as <code>Co-Authored-By</code> by default; pull request descriptions get plain text. Set each part separately with the sub-keys below.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object with <code>commit</code> and <code>pr</code> strings and a <code>sessionUrl</code> Boolean</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses the standard attribution shown under each sub-key</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example replaces the commit attribution, removes pull request attribution, and drops the session link:</span>

<span data-as="p">To hide all attribution, set <a class="link" href="#attribution-commit"><code>commit</code></a> and <a class="link" href="#attribution-pr"><code>pr</code></a> to empty strings and <a class="link" href="#attribution-sessionurl"><code>sessionUrl</code></a> to <code>false</code>. Once you set <code>commit</code> or <code>pr</code>, Claude Code ignores the deprecated <code>includeCoAuthoredBy</code> setting and uses its default text for whichever of the two you left unset.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="includecoauthoredby"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#includecoauthoredby">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>includeCoAuthoredBy</code></span></h3>
<div aria-label="Warning" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part='callout-icon']]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M 9 6.75 v 1.5 m 0 3 h 0.0075 m -5.2035 3 h 10.392 c 1.155 0 1.8765 -1.2503 1.299 -2.25 L 10.299 3 c -0.5775 -0.9997 -2.0205 -0.9997 -2.598 0 L 2.505 12 c -0.5775 0.9997 0.144 2.25 1.299 2.25 z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Deprecated since v2.0.62, when <a class="link" href="#attribution"><code>attribution</code></a> replaced it. Claude Code still reads it, but new configurations should set <code>attribution</code>.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">Use <a class="link" href="#attribution"><code>attribution</code></a> instead, which replaces this key and lets you change or hide the commit trailer, the pull request text, and the session link separately. Claude Code still honors <code>includeCoAuthoredBy: false</code> from settings files that predate <code>attribution</code>, but ignores it once you set <code>attribution.commit</code> or <code>attribution.pr</code>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the same as unset; Claude Code adds the commit trailer and the pull request attribution text</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code omits both the commit trailer and the pull request attribution text, unless <code>attribution</code> sets <code>commit</code> or <code>pr</code>, in which case the <a class="link" href="#attribution"><code>attribution</code></a> rules apply</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="includegitinstructions"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#includegitinstructions">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>includeGitInstructions</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">At session start, Claude Code adds two git-related pieces to Claude’s prompt: its built-in instructions for how to write commits and pull requests, in the Bash tool’s description, and a git status snapshot of your repository in the system prompt, meaning the current branch, the main branch, <code>git status</code> output, and recent commits. Set this key to <code>false</code> to leave both out, for example when you use your own git workflow skills.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code includes its built-in commit and pull request workflow instructions and the git status snapshot. Cloud sessions never include the snapshot</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code leaves both out</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Point the PR links Claude Code renders, in the footer badge and in tool-result summaries, at an internal code-review tool instead of <code>github.com</code>. Claude Code substitutes <code>{host}</code>, <code>{owner}</code>, <code>{repo}</code>, <code>{number}</code>, and <code>{url}</code> from the PR URL. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#gitlab-merge-requests">GitLab merge request</a> links on both surfaces keep their GitLab URL.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a URL template using any of the five placeholders</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code applies the template only to the links it renders itself; a PR number Claude writes in a message, such as <code>#123</code>, stays as Claude wrote it. A URL that doesn’t have the <code>/pull/&lt;number&gt;</code> shape is left unchanged.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="attribution-commit"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#attribution-commit">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>attribution.commit</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set the attribution text Claude Code adds to git commits, including any trailers. Set it to an empty string to hide commit attribution.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code adds <code>Co-Authored-By: &lt;name&gt; &lt;noreply@anthropic.com&gt;</code>. The name is the session’s active model, such as <code>Claude Sonnet 5</code>.<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>When Claude Code recognizes the model as a Claude model but can’t confirm its exact version, it writes <code>Claude</code> alone.</li>
<li>When it can’t match the model ID to any Claude model, such as a third-party model served through a custom <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL</code></a>, it writes <code>Claude Code</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example replaces the default trailer with a custom line and a custom <code>Co-Authored-By</code> trailer:</span>

<span data-as="p">Choose whether Claude Code appends the claude.ai session link when it commits or opens a pull request from a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web">cloud</a> or <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a> session. Claude Code adds the link as a <code>Claude-Session</code> trailer on commits and as a link in pull request descriptions. Set it to <code>false</code> to omit the link.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code appends the claude.ai session link when it commits or opens a pull request from a cloud or Remote Control session</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code omits the link</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="hooks-and-automation"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#hooks-and-automation">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Hooks and automation</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Register hooks, restrict which hooks run, and control workflows. For hook events and payloads, see the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks">hooks reference</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="allowedhttphookurls"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#allowedhttphookurls">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>allowedHttpHookUrls</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Limit which URLs <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#http-hook-fields">HTTP hooks</a> can target. When you define this key, Claude Code runs an HTTP hook only if its URL matches one of the patterns and blocks the rest without running them; an empty array blocks every HTTP hook.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Arrays merge across settings files.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of URL patterns, with <code>*</code> as a wildcard</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so any URL is allowed</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example allows any URL under <code>https://hooks.example.com/</code> and any <code>http://localhost</code> URL:</span>

<span data-as="p">Restrict hook execution to hooks your organization deploys.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: only managed hooks run, plus Agent SDK hooks and hooks from plugins your managed settings force-enable. See <a class="link" href="#what-runs-under-allowmanagedhooksonly">What runs under <code>allowManagedHooksOnly</code></a></li>
<li><code>false</code>: hooks from every settings scope and plugin run</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so hooks from every settings scope and plugin run</li>
</ul>

<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="what-runs-under-allowmanagedhooksonly"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#what-runs-under-allowmanagedhooksonly">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">What runs under <code>allowManagedHooksOnly</code></span></h4>
<span data-as="p">When you set it to <code>true</code>, Claude Code changes which hooks and hook-like commands load:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Managed and SDK hooks run</strong>: hooks from managed settings and hooks the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview">Agent SDK</a> registers in process</li>
<li><strong>Force-enabled plugin hooks run</strong>: hooks from plugins your managed settings force-enable through <a class="link" href="#enabledplugins"><code>enabledPlugins</code></a>. Claude Code matches on the full <code>plugin@marketplace</code> ID, so a plugin with the same name from a different marketplace stays blocked. This lets you distribute vetted hooks through an organization marketplace while blocking everything else</li>
<li><strong>Everything else is blocked</strong>: user, project, and local hooks, hooks from other plugins, and hooks declared in agent frontmatter</li>
<li><strong>Command-sourced plugins are disabled</strong>: Claude Code also disables plugins with a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces#command-sources"><code>command</code> source</a>, including plugins force-enabled in managed <code>enabledPlugins</code>, unless you set <a class="link" href="#disablecommandpluginsources"><code>disableCommandPluginSources</code></a> to <code>false</code> explicitly</li>
<li><strong>Marketplace <code>headersHelper</code> commands are blocked</strong>: Claude Code also blocks marketplace <a class="link" href="/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces#authenticate-archive-downloads"><code>headersHelper</code> commands</a> unless <a class="link" href="#disablecommandpluginsources"><code>disableCommandPluginSources</code></a> is explicitly set to <code>false</code>, except for a marketplace that managed settings themselves declare. Requires Claude Code v2.1.238 or later</li>
<li><strong>Status line and file suggestion narrow to managed settings</strong>: Claude Code reads <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline"><code>statusLine</code></a>, <a class="link" href="#filesuggestion"><code>fileSuggestion</code></a>, and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline#subagent-status-lines"><code>subagentStatusLine</code></a> from managed settings only, following the <a class="link" href="#status-line-and-file-suggestion-gates">status line and file suggestion gates</a></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The <a class="link" href="/docs/en/goal"><code>/goal</code></a> command can’t run while this key is set, because it depends on hooks.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disableallhooks"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#disableallhooks">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>disableAllHooks</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#disable-or-remove-hooks">hooks</a>, any custom <a class="link" href="/docs/en/statusline">status line</a>, and any custom <a class="link" href="#filesuggestion">file suggestion</a> command. Use it to turn all of these off temporarily without deleting them from your settings.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Only managed settings can disable managed hooks.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns off hooks, any custom status line, and any custom file suggestion command</li>
<li><code>false</code>: hooks, the status line, and the file suggestion command run</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so hooks run</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">The reach depends on which file carries the key:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>In managed settings</strong>: Claude Code disables every configured hook, including managed ones, and keeps running the hooks the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview">Agent SDK</a> registers in process</li>
<li><strong>In any other settings file</strong>: Claude Code disables user, project, local, and plugin hooks; managed hooks, Agent SDK hooks, and hooks from plugins force-enabled in managed <a class="link" href="#enabledplugins"><code>enabledPlugins</code></a> keep running</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Keeping Agent SDK hooks running when managed settings set this key requires Claude Code v2.1.242 or later.</span>
<span data-as="p">The <a class="link" href="/docs/en/goal"><code>/goal</code></a> command can’t run while hooks are disabled, and the <code>/hooks</code> menu shows a notice instead of your hooks.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="status-line-and-file-suggestion-gates"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#status-line-and-file-suggestion-gates">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Status line and file suggestion gates</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code makes two decisions for <code>statusLine</code>, <code>fileSuggestion</code>, and <code>subagentStatusLine</code>, in this order:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Off entirely</strong>: when managed settings set <code>disableAllHooks</code>, or when the folder isn’t trusted under the same <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permissions#what-runs-before-you-trust-a-folder">workspace trust rule as hooks in settings files</a></li>
<li><strong>Narrowed to managed settings</strong>: when <a class="link" href="#allowmanagedhooksonly"><code>allowManagedHooksOnly</code></a> is set, when <code>disableAllHooks</code> is <code>true</code> outside managed settings after <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#disable-or-remove-hooks">settings precedence</a> applies, or when you start Claude Code with <code>--safe-mode</code></li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Under narrowing, Claude Code runs a managed value if one is deployed. Otherwise it skips your value without warning: the status line is disabled, and <code>@</code> autocomplete falls back to the built-in file suggestion.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disableworkflows"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#disableworkflows">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>disableWorkflows</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off <a class="link" href="/docs/en/workflows#turn-workflows-off">dynamic workflows</a> and the bundled workflow commands for everyone your settings reach, such as an organization through managed settings. To turn workflows on or off just for yourself, use <a class="link" href="#enableworkflows"><code>enableWorkflows</code></a> instead, which the <strong>Dynamic workflows</strong> toggle in <code>/config</code> writes to your user settings.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns off dynamic workflows and the bundled workflow commands for everyone your settings reach</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the same as unset; whether workflows are on then follows <a class="link" href="#enableworkflows"><code>enableWorkflows</code></a> and your plan’s default</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS</code></a> turns workflows off for one session; whichever of the two turns them off, the other can’t turn them back on</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Turn <a class="link" href="/docs/en/workflows">dynamic workflows</a> on or off for yourself when your plan’s default isn’t what you want. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Dynamic workflows</strong>, which writes this key to your user settings and removes it again when you toggle back to your plan’s default. To turn workflows off for everyone from managed settings, use <a class="link" href="#disableworkflows"><code>disableWorkflows</code></a> instead.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns dynamic workflows on for you</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code turns dynamic workflows off for you</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so workflows are on unless you’re on the Pro plan, where they’re off</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS</code></a> turns workflows off for one session, and <code>true</code> here can’t turn them back on while it’s set</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p"><a class="link" href="#disableworkflows"><code>disableWorkflows</code></a> and your organization’s workflows policy also take precedence: <code>enableWorkflows: true</code> can’t turn workflows back on while any source turns workflows off. Claude Code hides the <code>/config</code> row while a source other than your user settings sets <code>enableWorkflows</code>, or sets <code>disableWorkflows</code> to <code>true</code>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="hooks"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#hooks">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>hooks</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run your own commands, prompts, agents, HTTP requests, or MCP tools as <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks">hooks</a> at points in Claude Code’s lifecycle, such as before a tool call or when a session starts; the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#hook-events">hooks reference</a> lists every event, its payload, and its exit codes. Each event maps to a list of matcher groups, and each group lists the handlers to run when the matcher applies.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Hooks merge across files rather than replacing each other, and hooks from managed settings can’t be removed from other files.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object keyed by <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#hook-events">hook event</a>; each value is an array of <code>{ "matcher", "hooks" }</code> groups whose <code>hooks</code> entries have a <code>type</code> of <code>"command"</code>, <code>"prompt"</code>, <code>"agent"</code>, <code>"http"</code>, or <code>"mcp_tool"</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no hooks run</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="httphookallowedenvvars"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#httphookallowedenvvars">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>httpHookAllowedEnvVars</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">An <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#http-hook-fields">HTTP hook</a> can put the value of an environment variable into a request header, for example an <code>Authorization: Bearer $HOOK_TOKEN</code> header, but only for variables the hook lists in its own <code>allowedEnvVars</code>. This key sets an outer limit on that list for every HTTP hook: a hook can use a variable only if both its own <code>allowedEnvVars</code> and this key name it. Use it to stop a hook from reading a secret it shouldn’t, even when the hook’s definition asks for it.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Arrays merge across settings files.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of environment variable names</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so each hook’s own <code>allowedEnvVars</code> list applies</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example limits header interpolation to <code>MY_TOKEN</code> and <code>HOOK_SECRET</code>:</span>

<span data-as="p">Choose whether typing the keyword <code>ultracode</code> in a prompt triggers a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/workflows#ask-for-a-workflow-in-your-prompt">dynamic workflow</a>. Set it to <code>false</code> to type the word without triggering one.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Ultracode keyword trigger</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: typing <code>ultracode</code> in a prompt triggers a dynamic workflow</li>
<li><code>false</code>: you can type the word without triggering one</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="workflowsizeguideline"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#workflowsizeguideline">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>workflowSizeGuideline</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Set the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/workflows#set-a-size-guideline">agent count Claude aims for</a> in the dynamic workflows it writes. Claude Code sends the value to Claude as advice, not an enforced cap: <code>"small"</code> asks for fewer than 5 agents, <code>"medium"</code> fewer than 15, and <code>"large"</code> fewer than 50. Choose <code>"small"</code> when you want to bound what a workflow spends. Requires Claude Code v2.1.219 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A value there takes precedence over the <strong>Dynamic workflow size</strong> choice in <code>/config</code>, which Claude Code stores in <code>~/.claude.json</code>, and Claude Code hides that row while a settings file sets the key.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"unrestricted"</code>: no guideline, so Claude sizes the workflow to the task</li>
<li><code>"small"</code>: Claude aims for fewer than 5 agents</li>
<li><code>"medium"</code>: Claude aims for fewer than 15 agents</li>
<li><code>"large"</code>: Claude aims for fewer than 50 agents</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"medium"</code></li>
</ul>
