<span data-as="p">A <a class="link" href="#deniedmcpservers"><code>deniedMcpServers</code></a> entry takes precedence, so a server on both lists is blocked. Once the list contains any <code>serverCommand</code> entry, a stdio server must match a <code>serverCommand</code> entry, and once it contains any <code>serverUrl</code> entry, a remote server must match a <code>serverUrl</code> entry: a <code>serverName</code> match no longer admits that kind of server. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-mcp#policy-based-control-with-allowlists-and-denylists">Policy-based control with allowlists and denylists</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="allowmanagedmcpserversonly"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#allowmanagedmcpserversonly">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>allowManagedMcpServersOnly</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Make the managed allowlist the only one that applies. Claude Code then reads <a class="link" href="#allowedmcpservers"><code>allowedMcpServers</code></a> from managed settings alone and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings; <a class="link" href="#deniedmcpservers"><code>deniedMcpServers</code></a> still merges from every settings scope, so users can still block servers for themselves. Administrators set it so a user’s own settings can’t broaden what the managed allowlist permits.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code reads <code>allowedMcpServers</code> from managed settings alone and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings</li>
<li><code>false</code>: allowlists from every settings scope merge</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code>, so allowlists from every settings scope merge</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example locks the allowlist to managed settings and allows only the server named <code>github</code>:</span>

<span data-as="p">Users can still add MCP servers of their own; only servers that match the managed allowlist load. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-mcp#restrict-the-allowlist-to-managed-settings-only">Restrict the allowlist to managed settings only</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="deniedmcpservers"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#deniedmcpservers">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>deniedMcpServers</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Block specific MCP servers. Claude Code refuses to load a matching server wherever it’s defined, including plugin servers, servers passed with <code>--mcp-config</code>, servers from <code>managed-mcp.json</code>, servers from <a class="link" href="#managedmcpservers"><code>managedMcpServers</code></a>, and the claude.ai connectors <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#how-connectors-reach-claude-code">it fetches itself</a>. In-process <code>type: "sdk"</code> servers are exempt; the app that started the session registers them.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Entries from every file merge into one denylist, and <a class="link" href="#allowmanagedmcpserversonly"><code>allowManagedMcpServersOnly</code></a> doesn’t change that. Deploy it in managed settings to enforce it.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with exactly one key: <code>serverName</code>, any non-empty string, so a claude.ai connector’s display name such as <code>"claude.ai Slack"</code> works; <code>serverCommand</code>, an array of the command and its arguments matched exactly; or <code>serverUrl</code>, a URL pattern with <code>*</code> wildcards</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so no server is blocked; an empty array also blocks nothing</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">The denylist takes precedence over <a class="link" href="#allowedmcpservers"><code>allowedMcpServers</code></a>, so a server on both lists is blocked. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-mcp#policy-based-control-with-allowlists-and-denylists">Policy-based control with allowlists and denylists</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disableclaudeaiconnectors"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#disableclaudeaiconnectors">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>disableClaudeAiConnectors</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#use-mcp-servers-from-claude-ai">claude.ai MCP connectors</a> <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#how-connectors-reach-claude-code">Claude Code fetches itself</a>, so it neither fetches nor connects them. A <code>true</code> in any settings file applies: a checked-in project <code>.claude/settings.json</code> can opt a repository out of those connectors, but a project-level <code>false</code> can’t override a user- or managed-level <code>true</code>. Requires Claude Code v2.1.182 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code neither fetches nor connects those connectors</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the same as unset; Claude Code fetches your connectors unless another settings file or <code>ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS</code> turns them off</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code>, so Claude Code fetches your connectors</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS</code></a> set to <code>false</code> turns connectors off for one session; whichever of the two turns them off, the other can’t turn them back on</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Reject specific servers defined in a project’s <code>.mcp.json</code> file so Claude Code never connects them or asks you to approve them. A rejection in any settings file applies, including a project <code>.claude/settings.json</code> checked into the repository.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, the server names as they appear in <code>.mcp.json</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code writes this key to <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> when you reject a server in the approval dialog. <code>claude mcp get &lt;name&gt;</code> shows a rejected server as <code>✘ Rejected (see disabledMcpjsonServers in settings)</code>. Rejection takes precedence over <a class="link" href="#enabledmcpjsonservers"><code>enabledMcpjsonServers</code></a> and <a class="link" href="#enableallprojectmcpservers"><code>enableAllProjectMcpServers</code></a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="enableallprojectmcpservers"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#enableallprojectmcpservers">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>enableAllProjectMcpServers</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Approve every MCP server defined in project <code>.mcp.json</code> files without a prompt. Claude Code writes this key to <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> when you choose to approve all servers in the approval dialog.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. In a folder whose trust dialog you haven’t accepted, Claude Code honors it from user settings, managed settings, and <code>--settings</code> and ignores it in the shared project file, both in the session and for <code>claude mcp list</code> and <code>claude mcp get</code>; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#project-server-approvals-and-workspace-trust">Project server approvals and workspace trust</a> says when an untracked <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> counts too.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code approves every MCP server defined in project <code>.mcp.json</code> files without a prompt</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code asks you to approve each server. In a trusted folder, a <code>false</code> in a higher-precedence file overrides a <code>true</code> in a lower one; in a folder you haven’t trusted, a <code>true</code> in any honored file is enough</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code asks you to approve each server</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Approve specific servers defined in project <code>.mcp.json</code> files so Claude Code connects them without asking. Claude Code writes this key to <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> when you approve a server in the approval dialog.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. In a folder whose trust dialog you haven’t accepted, Claude Code honors it from user settings, managed settings, and <code>--settings</code> and ignores it in the shared project file, both in the session and for <code>claude mcp list</code> and <code>claude mcp get</code>; <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#project-server-approvals-and-workspace-trust">Project server approvals and workspace trust</a> says when an untracked <code>.claude/settings.local.json</code> counts too.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, the server names as they appear in <code>.mcp.json</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example approves the <code>memory</code> and <code>github</code> servers from the project’s <code>.mcp.json</code>:</span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="managedmcpservers"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#managedmcpservers">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>managedMcpServers</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Provide remote MCP servers to every user from managed settings. Users keep the servers they add themselves and can’t edit or remove the ones you provide. Requires Claude Code v2.1.259 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a>. Claude Code drops the key with a warning in user, project, and local settings, and doesn’t read it in the Claude Desktop app’s Code tab on a third-party deployment or in the app’s Cowork sessions, where Claude Desktop supplies and locks those sessions’ MCP servers itself.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: object keyed by server name. Each entry has the <code>.mcp.json</code> shape for an <code>http</code> or <code>sse</code> server: a required <code>https://</code> <code>url</code>, and optionally <code>headers</code>, <code>oauth</code>, and the other HTTP and SSE options. Claude Code drops entries that fail validation, and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-mcp#what-an-entry-can-contain">What an entry can contain</a> lists the conditions</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so managed settings provide no servers</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="agents-sessions-and-worktrees"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#agents-sessions-and-worktrees">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Agents, sessions, and worktrees</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Set the default agent, control teammates and cross-session messaging, and configure worktrees. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents">Subagents</a> and <a class="link" href="/docs/en/worktrees">Worktrees</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="agent"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#agent">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>agent</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run the main thread as a named <a class="link" href="/docs/en/sub-agents#invoke-subagents-explicitly">subagent</a>, so Claude Code applies that subagent’s system prompt, tool restrictions, and model to your session. The same key sets the default agent for sessions you dispatch from <code>claude agents</code>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, the name of a built-in or custom agent</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the main thread runs as Claude Code’s default agent</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <code>--agent</code> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Choose what this session does with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cross-session-messaging#control-inbound-messages">messages arriving from your other Claude Code sessions</a>. When no value applies, Claude Code decides per message from the two sessions’ permission-mode classes. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A project or local value applies only when it’s stricter than the value managed settings, the <code>--settings</code> flag, or user settings give.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"accept"</code>: Claude Code delivers the message to Claude</li>
<li><code>"hold"</code>: Claude Code shows a notice for the message without delivering it</li>
<li><code>"refuse"</code>: Claude Code drops the message</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code decides per message</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code reads managed settings first, then the <code>--settings</code> flag, then user settings, and applies the first value found. <code>refuse</code> is stricter than <code>hold</code>, and <code>hold</code> is stricter than <code>accept</code>. When none of the trusted sources sets a value, a project or local <code>hold</code> or <code>refuse</code> still applies, replacing the per-message default. In sessions with cross-session messaging, this key appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Messages from your other sessions</strong>, which writes it to user settings; the row requires Claude Code v2.1.232 or later, and Claude Code hides it while the <code>--settings</code> flag or managed settings set the key.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Code <a class="link" href="/docs/en/errors#crosssessioninbound-must-be-one-of-accept-hold-refuse">warns</a> when you set a value it doesn’t recognize. While that value is present in a user, project, local, or <code>--settings</code> file, Claude Code holds inbound messages, even when a source that takes precedence sets <code>accept</code>. A <code>refuse</code> that another source sets still applies. Fix or remove the value to clear the hold.</span>
<span data-as="p">When the unrecognized value is in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings">managed settings</a>, Claude Code instead treats it as <code>refuse</code> until an administrator fixes it. Before v2.1.248, Claude Code ignored an unrecognized value without warning.</span>

<span data-as="p">Turn off <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-view">background agents and agent view</a>: <code>claude agents</code>, <code>--bg</code>, <code>/background</code>, and the on-demand supervisor. Set it in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings">managed settings</a> to enforce it for an organization.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns off <code>claude agents</code>, <code>--bg</code>, <code>/background</code>, and the on-demand supervisor</li>
<li><code>false</code>: agent view is available</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so agent view is available</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW</code></a> turns agent view off for one session; whichever of the two turns it off, the other can’t turn it back on</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Require your explicit approval before Claude’s <code>SendMessage</code> reaches one of your sessions beyond this machine; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cross-session-messaging#require-approval-for-cross-machine-messages">Require approval for cross-machine messages</a>. The approval prompt appears even in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes#skip-all-checks-with-bypasspermissions-mode"><code>bypassPermissions</code> mode</a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. A <code>true</code> from any scope applies, so a checked-in project file can turn the requirement on but not off.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code asks for your approval before Claude’s <code>SendMessage</code> reaches one of your sessions beyond this machine</li>
<li><code>false</code>: cross-machine messages don’t prompt</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so cross-machine messages don’t prompt</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">On macOS and Linux, place a corporate launcher command in front of the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/corporate-launcher#what-the-launcher-covers">background processes Claude Code starts</a>. Claude Code runs the launcher with its own command line appended, so the launcher must exec into Claude Code; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/corporate-launcher">Run Claude Code behind a corporate launcher</a> for the launcher contract. Requires Claude Code v2.1.210 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, the launcher command as an argv prefix, such as an absolute path with optional arguments</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so background processes start unwrapped</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="teammatemode"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#teammatemode">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>teammateMode</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose where Claude Code shows <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-teams">agent team</a> teammates: inside your main terminal pane, or in split panes when your terminal supports them. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-teams#choose-a-display-mode">Choose a display mode</a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code also reads a value left in <code>~/.claude.json</code> by older versions.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"in-process"</code>: teammates run inside your main terminal pane</li>
<li><code>"auto"</code>: split panes when you’re running inside tmux, or inside iTerm2 with <code>it2</code> on your <code>PATH</code> or tmux installed; in-process otherwise</li>
<li><code>"tmux"</code>: split panes using tmux or iTerm2, detected from your terminal</li>
<li><code>"iterm2"</code>: iTerm2 native split panes through the <code>it2</code> CLI, in Claude Code v2.1.186 or later</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"in-process"</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <code>--teammate-mode</code> takes precedence over this key for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Configure how Claude Code creates and manages <a class="link" href="/docs/en/worktrees">git worktrees</a> for <code>--worktree</code>, the <code>EnterWorktree</code> tool, and isolated subagents and background sessions.</span>

<span data-as="p">To copy gitignored files like <code>.env</code> into new worktrees, add a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/worktrees#copy-gitignored-files-into-worktrees"><code>.worktreeinclude</code> file</a> to your project root instead of a setting.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="worktree-baseref"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#worktree-baseref">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>worktree.baseRef</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Choose which ref new worktrees branch from. <code>"fresh"</code> branches from <code>origin/&lt;default-branch&gt;</code> for a clean tree matching the remote; <code>"head"</code> branches from your current local <code>HEAD</code>, so unpushed commits and feature-branch state are present in the worktree.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"fresh"</code>: new worktrees branch from <code>origin/&lt;default-branch&gt;</code></li>
<li><code>"head"</code>: new worktrees branch from your current local <code>HEAD</code>, including unpushed commits</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"fresh"</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Inside a linked worktree, <code>"head"</code> resolves to that worktree’s <code>HEAD</code>, not the main checkout’s.</span>

<span data-as="p">Symlink directories from the main repository into each worktree so you don’t duplicate large directories on disk.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code symlinks no directories</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Check out only the listed directories in each worktree through git sparse-checkout. Claude Code writes only those directories plus root-level files to disk, which is faster in large monorepos; see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/large-codebases#check-out-only-the-directories-you-need">Check out only the directories you need</a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so each worktree checks out the whole tree</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Choose how <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-view#how-file-edits-are-isolated">background sessions</a> isolate their file edits. With <code>"worktree"</code>, Claude Code blocks <code>Edit</code> and <code>Write</code> in the main checkout until the session calls <code>EnterWorktree</code>; with <code>"none"</code>, background jobs edit the working copy directly. Set <code>"none"</code> for a repository where git worktrees are impractical.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"worktree"</code>: Claude Code blocks <code>Edit</code> and <code>Write</code> in the main checkout until the session calls <code>EnterWorktree</code></li>
<li><code>"none"</code>: background jobs edit the working copy directly</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"worktree"</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Outside a git repository, a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/worktrees#non-git-version-control"><code>WorktreeCreate</code> hook</a> that fails releases the block so the session can edit the working directory in place; that release requires Claude Code v2.1.203 or later.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="remote-desktop-and-notifications"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#remote-desktop-and-notifications">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Remote, desktop, and notifications</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Configure Remote Control, cloud environments, the desktop app, and the notifications Claude Code sends when it needs you. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="agentpushnotifenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#agentpushnotifenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>agentPushNotifEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Allow Claude to send a push notification to your phone when it decides one is worth sending, for example when a long task finishes. Claude Code syncs this choice to your account, and pushes arrive while <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a> is connected. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Push when Claude decides</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code also reads a value left in <code>~/.claude.json</code> by older versions.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude can send a push notification to your phone when it decides one is worth sending</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude doesn’t send those notifications</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="awaysummaryenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#awaysummaryenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>awaySummaryEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Show a one-line session recap when you return to the terminal after a few minutes away. Set it to <code>false</code>, or turn off <strong>Session recap</strong> in <code>/config</code>, to stop the recap.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you see a one-line session recap when you return after a few minutes away</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code shows no recap</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the recap is on</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction</li>
</ul>

<div aria-label="Warning" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part='callout-icon']]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M 9 6.75 v 1.5 m 0 3 h 0.0075 m -5.2035 3 h 10.392 c 1.155 0 1.8765 -1.2503 1.299 -2.25 L 10.299 3 c -0.5775 -0.9997 -2.0205 -0.9997 -2.598 0 L 2.505 12 c -0.5775 0.9997 0.144 2.25 1.299 2.25 z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">Deprecated, and replaced by <a class="link" href="#enableartifact"><code>enableArtifact</code></a>. Claude Code still honors <code>disableArtifact: true</code> as equivalent to <code>enableArtifact: false</code>, and ignores <code>disableArtifact: false</code>.</span></div></div>
<span data-as="p">Use <a class="link" href="#enableartifact"><code>enableArtifact</code></a> instead to turn off the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts">Artifact</a> tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai. When you turn the <strong>Artifacts</strong> row off in <code>/config</code>, Claude Code writes <code>enableArtifact</code> to your user settings and clears this key.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code turns the Artifact tool off for every session the file applies to, and no other file turns it back on. Before v2.1.242, a higher-precedence file could override a lower file’s <code>true</code> rather than the key acting as a lock</li>
<li><code>false</code>: ignored; to leave the tool on, remove the key</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the tool follows your account’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts#availability">availability</a></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT</code></a> set to <code>1</code> turns the tool off for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Stop Claude Code from registering the <code>claude-cli://</code> protocol handler with the operating system, which it otherwise does after you send the first prompt of an interactive session. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/deep-links">Deep links</a> let external tools open a Claude Code session with a pre-filled prompt. Set this in environments where protocol handler registration is restricted or managed separately.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: the string <code>"disable"</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code registers the handler</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disabledesktoplocalsessions"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#disabledesktoplocalsessions">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>disableDesktopLocalSessions</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off Code sessions that run on the device in the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/desktop#local-sessions-on-managed-devices">desktop app</a>, for deployments where developers should work on remote machines over SSH. In the Code tab, the <strong>Local</strong> environment stays in the environment dropdown but is grayed out and can’t be selected, with a tooltip saying your organization turned it off; on Windows the WSL entry is grayed out the same way, though whether WSL sessions run on a managed device at all is <a class="link" href="/docs/en/admin-setup#wsl-sessions-in-claude-code-desktop">governed separately</a>. New sessions default to the first <a class="link" href="/docs/en/desktop#ssh-sessions">SSH connection</a> if one is configured, and the app refuses to start or resume a session on the device, including an SSH connection back to the same machine. SSH sessions to other hosts and cloud sessions are unaffected. The desktop app reads this key; the terminal CLI ignores it. Requires Claude Desktop v1.37937.0 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean; only the JSON Boolean <code>true</code> takes effect<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the desktop app offers no on-device Code sessions; existing local sessions stay listed but can’t continue</li>
<li><code>false</code>: local sessions stay available</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so local sessions are available</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">The desktop app ignores any other value, and a value that isn’t a Boolean, such as the string <code>"true"</code> or <code>1</code>, also logs a warning. Pair it with <a class="link" href="#sshconfigs"><code>sshConfigs</code></a> so users land on a working connection, and with <a class="link" href="#sshhostallowlist"><code>sshHostAllowlist</code></a> to limit which hosts they can reach. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/desktop#local-sessions-on-managed-devices">Local sessions on managed devices</a>.</span>
<span data-as="p">Claude Desktop supplies Code sessions with policy derived from your desktop configuration, for example the egress allowlist, filesystem sandbox, and MCP restrictions in third-party deployments. Claude Code ignores those parent settings whenever an <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#how-claude-code-combines-managed-sources">admin source</a> is present: server-managed settings, an MDM or OS-level policy, or a managed settings file. Deploying this key through one of those on a device that had none before, as in third-party deployments, therefore stops the desktop-derived policies from applying. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings#let-an-embedding-host-add-policy">Let an embedding host add policy</a> covers when parent settings can still merge; this holds for any key you deploy that way, not only this one.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="disableremotecontrol"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#disableremotecontrol">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>disableRemoteControl</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a>: Claude Code then refuses <code>claude remote-control</code>, the <code>--remote-control</code> flag, auto-start, and the in-session toggle, and reports that your organization’s policy disabled it. Place it in <a class="link" href="/docs/en/managed-settings">managed settings</a> for per-device MDM enforcement.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code refuses <code>claude remote-control</code>, the <code>--remote-control</code> flag, auto-start, and the in-session toggle</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Remote Control stays available</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="enableartifact"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#enableartifact">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>enableArtifact</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Turn off the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts">Artifact</a> tool, which publishes session output as a private web page on claude.ai. When you turn the <strong>Artifacts</strong> row off in <code>/config</code>, Claude Code writes this key to your user settings, so you don’t usually edit it by hand. Requires Claude Code v2.1.196 or later.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Every file can turn the tool off, and none can turn it back on.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code turns the Artifact tool off for every session the file applies to</li>
<li><code>true</code>: the same as leaving the key unset, because it never overrides a <code>false</code> from another file, from <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT</code></a>, or from your organization’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts#manage-artifacts-for-your-organization">admin setting</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so the tool follows your account’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts#availability">availability</a></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">While a source other than your own user settings keeps the tool turned off, Claude Code hides the <strong>Artifacts</strong> row in <code>/config</code>, because turning it on there wouldn’t change anything. <a class="link" href="/docs/en/artifacts#disable-artifacts">Disable artifacts</a> lists every way to turn the tool off. Before v2.1.242, Claude Code ignored this key in project and local settings, and a file higher in the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings#settings-precedence">precedence stack</a> could turn the tool back on over a lower file’s off.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="inputneedednotifenabled"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#inputneedednotifenabled">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>inputNeededNotifEnabled</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Get a push notification on your phone when a permission prompt or question is waiting for your input. Claude Code sends these only while <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a> is connected. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Push when actions required</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code also reads a value left in <code>~/.claude.json</code> by older versions.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: you get a push notification on your phone when a permission prompt or question is waiting, while Remote Control is connected</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code sends no such notifications</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Choose how Claude Code notifies you when a task completes or a permission prompt is waiting. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Local notifications</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code also reads a value left in <code>~/.claude.json</code> by older versions.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"auto"</code>: Claude Code sends a desktop notification in iTerm2, Ghostty, and Kitty, rings the bell in Terminal.app only when its audible bell is off, and does nothing elsewhere</li>
<li><code>"terminal_bell"</code>: Claude Code rings the bell character in any terminal</li>
<li><code>"iterm2"</code>: Claude Code sends an iTerm2 desktop notification</li>
<li><code>"iterm2_with_bell"</code>: Claude Code sends an iTerm2 desktop notification and rings the bell</li>
<li><code>"kitty"</code>: Claude Code sends a Kitty desktop notification</li>
<li><code>"ghostty"</code>: Claude Code sends a Ghostty desktop notification</li>
<li><code>"notifications_disabled"</code>: Claude Code sends no notification</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"auto"</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">With <code>"auto"</code>, Claude Code sends a desktop notification in iTerm2, Ghostty, and Kitty. In Terminal.app it rings the bell character only when you have turned Terminal’s audible bell off, and in other terminals it does nothing. Set <code>"terminal_bell"</code> to ring the bell character in any terminal. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/terminal-config#get-a-terminal-bell-or-notification">Get a terminal bell or notification</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="remote-defaultenvironmentid"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#remote-defaultenvironmentid">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>remote.defaultEnvironmentId</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Pick the default <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments">cloud environment</a> for cloud sessions you create from the CLI, such as with <code>claude --cloud</code>. Claude Code writes this key to your user settings when you pick an environment with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments#select-an-environment-from-the-cli"><code>/remote-env</code></a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. For a self-hosted environment ID, user or managed settings, or the <code>--settings</code> flag only.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, an environment ID such as <code>env_...</code> or <code>ccpool_...</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses the Anthropic-hosted environment when your list has one, and otherwise the first environment in your list that isn’t a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/cloud-environments#the-default-environment">Remote Control bridge environment</a>, or the first environment when every one is a bridge environment</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <code>--environment</code> takes precedence over this key for the one cloud session it creates</li>
</ul>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#D4D4D4">}</span></span>

<span data-as="p">An Anthropic-hosted environment ID, which starts with <code>env_</code>, follows the standard settings precedence, so a value in a repository’s project settings overrides your user-level pick. A <a class="link" href="/docs/en/self-hosted-environments">self-hosted environment</a> ID, which starts with <code>ccpool_</code>, is honored only from user settings, managed settings, and the <code>--settings</code> flag; Claude Code ignores one in a repository’s project or local settings, and <code>/remote-env</code> shows which value it ignored, so a checked-in file can’t steer sessions onto a self-hosted environment you didn’t choose.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="remotecontrolatstartup"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#remotecontrolatstartup">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>remoteControlAtStartup</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Connect <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control">Remote Control</a> automatically when each interactive session starts, instead of waiting for <code>/remote-control</code>. Set it to <code>true</code> to turn auto-connect on, <code>false</code> to turn it off. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Enable Remote Control for all sessions</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a>. Claude Code also reads a value left in <code>~/.claude.json</code> by older versions.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code connects Remote Control automatically when each interactive session starts</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code waits for <code>/remote-control</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so auto-connect follows your organization’s admin default when one is set, and otherwise Claude Code’s current default</li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <code>--remote-control</code> turns Remote Control on for one session even when this key is <code>false</code>, and no flag turns it off for one session</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code ignores a <code>true</code> from project or local settings, so a repository can turn auto-connect off for its checkout but can’t turn it on. For the full per-scope behavior, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/remote-control#enable-remote-control-for-all-sessions">Enable Remote Control for all sessions</a> and the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/settings#security-keys-where-the-stricter-value-applies">security keys where the stricter value applies</a>.</span>

<span data-as="p">Add SSH connections to the <a class="link" href="/docs/en/desktop#pre-configure-ssh-connections-for-your-team">Desktop</a> environment dropdown. Administrators use it to distribute shared connections to a team. Connections you define in managed settings show as managed, so users can select them but can’t edit or delete them in the app.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>User or managed</code></a>. The desktop app reads this key.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of objects, each with required <code>id</code>, <code>name</code>, and <code>sshHost</code> and optional <code>sshPort</code> and <code>sshIdentityFile</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="sshhostallowlist"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#sshhostallowlist">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>sshHostAllowlist</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Limit the hosts a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/desktop#restrict-which-ssh-hosts-users-can-connect-to">Desktop SSH session</a> can connect to. Only the Desktop app reads this key; the CLI doesn’t. Patterns are case-insensitive: <code>*</code> matches any host, <code>*.example.com</code> matches <code>example.com</code> and every subdomain, and anything else is an exact match against the hostname after <code>~/.ssh/config</code> resolution. An empty array turns SSH sessions off.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Managed</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: array of hostname patterns</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so any host is allowed</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">This example allows <code>devboxes.example.com</code> and its subdomains, plus the exact host <code>bastion.example.com</code>:</span>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="apikeyhelper"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#apikeyhelper">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>apiKeyHelper</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run your own command to produce the credential Claude Code sends with model requests. Claude Code runs the command through the system shell, <code>/bin/sh</code> on macOS and Linux and <code>cmd</code> on Windows, and sends its output as both the <code>X-Api-Key</code> and <code>Authorization: Bearer</code> headers. Use it for dynamic or rotating credentials, such as short-lived tokens fetched from a vault.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a shell command line</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code doesn’t run a helper</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Claude Code caches the value and reruns the command in these cases:</span>
<ul>
<li>After the cache lifetime, five minutes by default or the interval you set with <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS</code></a>.</li>
<li>When a request to the Anthropic API, directly or through an <a class="link" href="/docs/en/llm-gateway">LLM gateway</a>, fails with <code>401</code> or <code>403</code>.</li>
<li>Before sending a request to the Anthropic API, directly or through an LLM gateway, when the cached output is a JWT that expired after the helper produced it. Requires Claude Code v2.1.246 or later.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">The last two cases apply only when the helper’s output is the credential Claude Code sends and <code>ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN</code> isn’t set.</span>
<span data-as="p">In interactive sessions, when the command comes from project or local settings, Claude Code doesn’t run it until you accept the workspace trust prompt. See <a class="link" href="/docs/en/authentication#credential-management">Credential management</a>.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="awsauthrefresh"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#awsauthrefresh">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>awsAuthRefresh</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Run your own command, such as <code>aws sso login</code>, to refresh the credentials in your <code>.aws</code> directory when the ones Claude Code has for <a class="link" href="/docs/en/amazon-bedrock">Amazon Bedrock</a> stop working. Claude Code checks the current credentials against STS first and runs the command only when that check fails, then reads the refreshed <code>.aws</code> directory.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a shell command line</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code doesn’t refresh AWS credentials for you</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Run your own command that prints AWS credentials as JSON, so Claude Code can call <a class="link" href="/docs/en/amazon-bedrock">Amazon Bedrock</a> with credentials that don’t live in your <code>.aws</code> directory. Claude Code accepts the <code>aws sts</code> output shape and the flat <code>aws configure export-credentials</code> shape, and scopes the credentials to its own Bedrock client, so the shell commands Claude runs still see your ambient credentials.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Any file</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a shell command line</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset, so Claude Code uses the ambient AWS credential chain</li>
</ul>
