<span data-as="p">Once an admin source turns the chain on, HKCU policy joins it on WSL only when HKCU also sets the key to <code>true</code>. That copy doesn’t turn the chain on by itself. A Windows source that contains only this key doesn’t count as a policy source, so a lower-priority source still supplies the policy. This key has no effect on native Windows.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="global-config-settings"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#global-config-settings">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Global config settings</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Save these keys in <code>~/.claude.json</code>, not in a settings file. Claude Code ignores them anywhere else. Claude Code and <code>/config</code> write most of them for you, and you can also edit them by hand.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="autoconnectide"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="Navigate to header" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#autoconnectide">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>autoConnectIde</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Connect to a running IDE automatically when you start Claude Code from an external terminal. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Auto-connect to IDE (external terminal)</strong> when you run Claude Code outside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Global config</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code connects to a running IDE automatically when you start it from an external terminal</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code doesn’t connect automatically from an external terminal; inside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal, or with <code>--ide</code>, it still connects</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE</code></a> takes precedence over this key for one session, in either direction</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Install the Claude Code IDE extension automatically when you run Claude Code from a VS Code terminal. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Auto-install IDE extension</strong> when you run Claude Code inside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Global config</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Claude Code installs the IDE extension automatically when you run it from a VS Code terminal</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Claude Code doesn’t install the extension automatically</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>true</code></li>
<li><strong>Per-session overrides</strong>: <a class="link" href="/docs/en/env-vars"><code>CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL</code></a> set to <code>1</code> skips the install for one session even when this key is <code>true</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Choose where Claude Code shows the diff of an <code>Edit</code> or <code>Write</code> change it proposes when a <a class="link" href="/docs/en/vs-code">VS Code</a> or <a class="link" href="/docs/en/jetbrains#features">JetBrains</a> IDE is connected: <code>"auto"</code> opens it in the IDE’s diff viewer, <code>"terminal"</code> keeps it in the terminal. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Diff tool</strong> only while Claude Code is connected to a VS Code or JetBrains IDE.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Global config</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, one of:<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>"auto"</code>: Claude Code opens the diff in the IDE’s diff viewer when a VS Code or JetBrains IDE is connected</li>
<li><code>"terminal"</code>: Claude Code keeps the diff in the terminal</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>"auto"</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">When you press <code>Ctrl+G</code>, Claude Code opens the prompt you’re typing in your <a class="link" href="/docs/en/interactive-mode#general-controls">external editor</a>. With this key on, the editor buffer starts with Claude’s previous response as <code>#</code> comment lines, so you can read it while you write, and Claude Code strips those lines when you save. Appears in <code>/config</code> as <strong>Show last response in external editor</strong>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Global config</code></a></li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: Boolean<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: the editor buffer starts with Claude’s previous response as <code>#</code> comment lines, which Claude Code strips when you save</li>
<li><code>false</code>: the editor buffer opens with only your prompt</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: <code>false</code></li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Through v2.1.233, you set this key to the model for <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-teams#specify-teammates-and-models">agent team</a> teammates your prompt didn’t name a model for: an alias such as <code>"sonnet"</code>, or <code>null</code> to follow the lead’s model. For the model Claude Code picks for such teammates now, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-teams#specify-teammates-and-models">specify teammates and models</a>.</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Scope</strong>: <a class="link" href="#scopes"><code>Global config</code></a>. On v2.1.233 and earlier.</li>
<li><strong>Type</strong>: string, a model alias or full model ID, or <code>null</code></li>
<li><strong>Default</strong>: unset</li>
